text: The ESA sample(s) of the rear lamp shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
test_case: Inspect the submitted lamp samples for a clearly legible, indelible trade name/mark and type designation; pass if both are present and survive rub testing.

text: An ESA brought to the market as a replacement part does not need a type approval only if it is obviously marked as a replacement part by an identification number and if it is identical and from the same manufacturer as the corresponding original equipment.
quote: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval if they are obviously marked as a replacement part
condition: Lamp is supplied as a replacement part without its own R10 type approval
test_case: Check the replacement lamp carries a replacement-part identification number and matches the original equipment part and manufacturer; pass if all conditions are met.

text: In case the ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128 granted to this ESA, or provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37
condition: The LED module/ESA is (part of) a light source
test_case: Review the approval file for an R37/R99/R128 approval number or a Technical Service report of non-interchangeability; pass if one is present.

text: If the ESA is sold as aftermarket equipment intended for installation in motor vehicles and is not related to immunity related functions (see paragraph 2.12.), a declaration shall be issued by the manufacturer that the ESA fulfils the requirements of this Regulation and in particular the limits defined in paragraphs 6.5., 6.6., 6.7., 6.8. and 6.9. of this Regulation.
quote: In this case a declaration shall be issued by the manufacturer that the ESA fulfils the requirements of this Regulation
condition: The rear lamp is sold as aftermarket equipment without type approval and is not related to immunity related functions
test_case: Check that the manufacturer's declaration exists and references compliance with the limits of paragraphs 6.5. to 6.9.

text: The representative ESA system(s) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation for type approval to be granted.
quote: If the representative ESA system(s) fulfil(s) the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation, type approval shall be granted.
test_case: Review the test report for the representative lamp ESA; pass if all paragraph 6 requirements are met.

text: In case the ESA is (part of) a light source and the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.
quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source and if the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. above is missing
condition: The LED module/ESA is (part of) a light source
test_case: Verify the documentation per paragraph 3.2.10. is present before approval; pass if it is available.

text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
test_case: Inspect the production lamp for the R10 approval mark per paragraph 5.3; pass if present (or the lamp is only covered by a vehicle-unit approval).

text: The international approval mark shall be affixed in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form.
quote: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form
test_case: Inspect the ESA and verify the approval mark is located at the place specified on the communication form and is accessible.

text: The approval mark of the ESA shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the lamp; pass if it shows a circle with 'E' and the approving country number.

text: The approval mark of the ESA shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle
test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the lamp; pass if '10R-' followed by the approval number appears to the right of the E-circle.

text: The ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle
test_case: Review the design and EMC test results of the lamp; pass if the lamp meets the R10 emission and immunity requirements in normal use.

text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
test_case: Check the test report covers radiated and conducted emissions and radiated and conducted immunity tests on the lamp; pass if all four are performed and passed.

text: Before testing, a test plan shall be prepared in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.
quote: the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s)
test_case: Review the EMC test plan for the lamp; pass if it defines operating modes, stimulated and monitored functions, pass/fail criteria and intended emissions.

text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
test_case: Perform broadband radiated emission measurement per Annex 7 on the lamp ESA; pass if the test is completed per the method.
merged: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA (rear lamp) representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically
test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 30 to 75 MHz; pass if all values are below the logarithmically decreasing 62-52 dBµV/m limit.
merged: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
quote: 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz
test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 75 to 400 MHz; pass if all values are below the 52-63 dBµV/m limit line of Appendix 6.
merged: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 52 to 63 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA broadband limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 400 to 1,000 MHz; pass if all values are below 63 dBµV/m.
merged: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA broadband limit remains constant at 63 dBµV/m.
If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA narrowband limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.

text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
test_case: Compare Annex 7 broadband measurement results with the 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if all values are below the limits.
merged: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
On the ESA (rear lamp) representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dBµV/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically
test_case: Measure narrowband emissions per Annex 8 from 30 to 75 MHz; pass if all values are below the 52-42 dBµV/m limit line.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
quote: 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7
test_case: Measure narrowband emissions per Annex 8 from 75 to 400 MHz; pass if all values are below the 42-53 dBµV/m limit line of Appendix 7.

text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances of the ESA representative of its type on 12/24 V supply lines shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
quote: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10
test_case: Perform ISO 7637-2 transient emission test per Annex 10 on the lamp supply lines, unless exempted per 6.10.5.

text: The maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted emissions generated by the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems, as given in Table 1.
quote: Maximum allowed pulse amplitude for Polarity of pulse amplitude Vehicles with 12 V systems Vehicles with 24 V systems Positive +75 V +150 V
test_case: Record transient emissions per ISO 7637-2; pass if positive pulse amplitudes do not exceed +75 V (12 V) or +150 V (24 V).
merged: The maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted emissions generated by the ESA shall be -100 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and -450 V for vehicles with 24 V systems, as given in Table 1.

text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
quote: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
test_case: Perform radiated immunity test using a method chosen from Annex 9 on the lamp, unless exempted per 6.10.3.

text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 with the test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2a and the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a. Test severity for the minimum test Level
test_case: Verify test report shows Annex 9 radiated immunity test at Table 2a levels over >90% of band and Table 2b minimum levels over whole band.

text: For the ALSE method, the ESA shall be tested at 30 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole of the 80 to 2,000 MHz range, and at 10 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 8 V/m over the whole of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz range (Tables 2a and 2b).
quote: Frequency range above 2 GHz Not applicable Not applicable Not applicable 2,000 to 6,000 MHz 2,000 to 6,000 MHz Test level above 2 GHz
condition: ALSE method chosen
test_case: Check ALSE test levels: 30/25 V/m for 80-2,000 MHz and 10/8 V/m for 2,000-6,000 MHz with no degradation.

text: For the stripline method, the ESA shall be tested in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range at 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the band (Table 2a) and a minimum of 50 V/m over the whole band (Table 2b).
quote: Stripline TEM cell BCI ALSE Reverberation chamber Frequency range below 2 GHz 20 to 400 MHz
condition: Stripline method chosen
test_case: Check stripline test levels: 60 V/m over >90% and ≥50 V/m over 20-400 MHz with no degradation.
merged: For the TEM cell method, the ESA shall be tested in the 20 to 200 MHz frequency range at 75 V/m in over 90 per cent of the band (Table 2a) and a minimum of 62,5 V/m over the whole band (Table 2b).
For the BCI method, the ESA shall be tested in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range at 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the band (Table 2a) and a minimum of 50 mA over the whole band (Table 2b).

text: For the reverberation chamber method, the ESA shall be tested at 21 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 18 V/m over the whole of the LUF to 2,000 MHz range, and at 7 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 6 V/m over the whole of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz range (Tables 2a and 2b).
quote: Not applicable Not applicable Not applicable 10 V/m 7 V/m
condition: Reverberation chamber method chosen
test_case: Check reverberation chamber levels: 21/18 V/m for LUF-2,000 MHz and 7/6 V/m for 2,000-6,000 MHz with no degradation.

text: Where the ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.
quote: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz
condition: Lamp electronics contain no oscillator above 9 kHz (driver electronics unknown)
test_case: Review circuit design/BOM for oscillators >9 kHz; if none, narrowband test may be waived.

text: While tests are performed in accordance with Annex 9, the ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
quote: shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation
test_case: Monitor lamp functions (e.g. stop lamp) during Annex 9 tests; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
quote: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2
test_case: Perform conducted transient immunity tests per Annex 10 with Table 3a/3b levels; pass if required classes are met.

text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
quote: Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
test_case: Verify starting profile test results are classified per ISO 16750-1.

text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
quote: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
test_case: Verify pulse test results are classified using ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 1 -75 V -450 V 500 pulses III III
test_case: Apply pulse 1 at -75 V/-450 V, 500 pulses; pass if FPSC III achieved.
merged: For pulse 2a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +37 V (12V system) or +37 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.

For pulse 2b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +10 V (12V system) or +20 V (24V system) for 10 pulses with FPSC II for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.

For pulse 3b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +75 V (12V system) or +150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.

text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 3a -112 V -150 V 1 h I III
test_case: Apply pulse 3a at -112 V/-150 V for 1 h; pass if FPSC I / III achieved.

text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
quote: Starting profile II II 10 pulses (for ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases) C (for other ESA)
condition: Lamp may be installed in vehicles with ICE started by 12 V starter motor
test_case: Apply 12 V starting profile level II, 10 pulses; pass if lamp reaches required class B/C/D.
merged: For the 24 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.

text: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation.
quote: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8.
condition: Lamp has no immunity related functions (stop/position lamp functions likely immunity related)
test_case: Assess whether lamp functions are immunity related per Annex 9; if none, radiated immunity test may be waived.

text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
quote: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission
condition: Lamp is not switched, contains no switches or has no inductive load
test_case: Review lamp circuit for switches/inductive loads; if none, transient emission test may be waived.

text: In the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth 30-75 MHz 75-400 MHz 400-1,000 MHz E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30)
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 from 30-75 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth; pass if all readings are at or below 62 - 25.13 log(F/30) dBµV/m.
merged: In the frequency range 400-1,000 MHz, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 63 dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).

text: In the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions from 75-400 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth; pass if all readings are at or below 52 + 15.13 log(F/75) dBµV/m.

text: In the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the narrowband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).
quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth 30-75 MHz 75-400 MHz 400-1,000 MHz E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30)
condition: The lamp contains electronics generating narrowband emissions (e.g. microcontroller/clocked LED driver).
test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions per Annex 8 from 30-75 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth; pass if all readings are at or below 52 - 25.13 log(F/30) dBµV/m.
merged: In the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the narrowband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).

In the frequency range 400-1,000 MHz, the narrowband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 53 dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).

text: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
quote: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
test_case: Review test setup/report; pass if a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN per Figure 1 is used on the LV supply lines of the lamp.

text: The AN(s) used for testing the LV-powered ESA shall be mounted directly on the ground plane.
quote: The AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane.
test_case: Inspect test setup; pass if the AN(s) are mounted directly on the ground plane.

text: The grounding connection of the AN(s) used for testing the LV-powered ESA shall be bonded to the ground plane.
quote: The grounding connection of the AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane.
test_case: Inspect test setup; pass if the AN grounding connection is bonded to the ground plane.

text: Measurement ports of AN(s) used for testing the LV-powered ESA shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
quote: Measurement ports of AN(s) shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
test_case: Inspect test setup; pass if all AN measurement ports are terminated with 50 Ω loads.

text: The AN impedance ZPB shall be within a tolerance of ± 20 % of the characteristic shown in Figure 2 in the measurement frequency range of 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz, measured between terminals P and B with a 50 Ω load on the measurement port and terminals A and B short circuited.
quote: The AN impedance ZPB (tolerance ± 20 %) in the measurement frequency range of 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz is shown in Figure 2.
test_case: Check AN calibration record; pass if ZPB from 0,1 to 100 MHz is within ±20 % of Figure 2.

text: The approval mark affixed to the ESA shall follow the layout of Model A or Model B (see paragraph 5.2. of this Regulation), with the characteristic dimension a of at least 6 mm.
quote: Model A (See paragraph 5.2. of this Regulation) a = 6 mm min The above approval mark affixed to a vehicle or ESA
condition: Lamp contains electronic content (LED driver/control electronics) requiring separate UN R10 ESA approval and marking
test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the lamp and measure dimension a; pass if the layout matches Model A/B and a ≥ 6 mm.

text: In the "50 km/h mode" vehicle immunity test, with dipped beams ON (manual mode), the lighting (front light and rear light, including the rear position lamps) shall not switch OFF.
quote: Dipped beams ON (manual mode) Lighting OFF (front light and rear light)
test_case: During the vehicle immunity test in 50 km/h mode with dipped beams on, monitor the rear lamp by video; pass if the rear position light never switches off.

text: In the "50 km/h mode" vehicle immunity test, with the brake pedal not depressed, there shall be no unexpected activation of brake and no unexpected activation of stop lights.
quote: Brake pedal not depressed Unexpected activation of brake and unexpected activation of stop lights
condition: Only if the lamp is assessed as part of a vehicle immunity test per Annex 6 (vehicle-level approval), not as an ESA
test_case: During the 50 km/h mode irradiation per ISO 11451-2, monitor the stop lamp by camera; pass if the stop lamp is never unexpectedly activated.

text: In the "Brake mode" vehicle immunity test, with the brake pedal depressed to activate the brake function and the stop lights without any dynamic cycle, the stop lights shall not be inactivated during the mode.
quote: Brake pedal depressed to activate the brake function and the stop lights without any dynamic cycle. Stop lights inactivated during mode
condition: Only if the lamp is assessed as part of a vehicle immunity test per Annex 6 (vehicle-level approval), not as an ESA
test_case: During brake mode irradiation per ISO 11451-2, monitor the stop lamp by camera; pass if the stop lamp remains lit throughout.

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 7, the measurement of broadband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
quote: If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according CISPR 25.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Review the test report to confirm that radiated broadband emissions were measured per CISPR 25 as referenced in Annex 7.

text: During the radiated broadband emission test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Check the test set-up record that the lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) were energised in normal operation at maximum load during measurement.
merged: During the narrowband emissions test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.

text: If the radiated broadband emission test is not performed with a REESS, the ESA should be tested at rated current.
quote: If the test is not performed with a REESS the ESA should be tested at rated current.
test_case: Verify in the test report that the lamp ESA was supplied and operated at its rated current during the emission measurement.

text: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the radiated broadband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
quote: the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Verify in the test report that the ALSE method of CISPR 25 Clause 6.4 (or an OATS per CISPR 16-1-4 as alternative) was used.

text: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.
quote: measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Confirm the report contains an ambient scan taken before or after the main test.

text: In the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Compare the ambient scan with the paragraph 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if at least 6 dB margin except intentional narrowband transmissions.

text: The radiated broadband emission limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Verify the emission scan covers 30 to 1,000 MHz and all readings are below the applicable limits.
merged: The narrowband emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

text: If peak detectors are used for the radiated broadband emission measurement, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
quote: If peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics and peak detector is used
test_case: Check that peak readings were compared to quasi-peak limits with the 20 dB correction applied.

text: The radiated broadband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2 (30 to 1,000 MHz: peak RBW 100/120 kHz, min scan time 100 ms/MHz; quasi-peak RBW 120 kHz, min scan time 20 s/MHz; scanning receiver BW 120 kHz, max step 60 kHz, min dwell 5 ms peak / 1 s quasi-peak).
quote: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver. The parameters to be used are defined in Table 1 and Table 2.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Review instrument settings in the test report against Table 1/Table 2 parameters.

text: If FFT-based measuring instruments are used, they shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time, with a minimum measurement time of 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode).
quote: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode)
condition: Lamp contains active electronics and FFT-based instrument is used
test_case: Check FFT instrument settings record ≥1 s measurement time per analysis band with continuous evaluation.
merged: If FFT-based measuring instruments are used, they shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time, with a minimum measurement time of 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode).

text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
quote: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
condition: Lamp contains active electronics and a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements
test_case: Verify recorded VBW ≥ 3 × RBW in the instrument settings.
merged: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video band width shall be at least three times the resolution band width (RBW).

text: The radiated broadband emission test of the ESA shall be performed at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
test_case: Review the test report and confirm that measurements cover 30 to 1,000 MHz at the CISPR 12 intervals.
merged: The narrowband emissions test of the ESA shall be performed at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
quote: Unless otherwise specified the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Inspect test set-up photos to confirm the LV harness is placed closest to the antenna.

text: The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.
quote: The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Check set-up drawing/photos showing antenna phase centre aligned with harness centre.

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.
quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Where exceedances occur, verify the report documents investigation distinguishing ESA emissions from background.

text: If the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, the frequency range may be divided into the 14 frequency bands 30-34, 34-45, 45-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100-130, 130-170, 170-225, 225-300, 300-400, 400-525, 525-700, 700-850 and 850-1,000 MHz, with tests at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band, to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of Annex 7.
condition: Manufacturer provides full-band measurement data from an ISO 17025 accredited laboratory recognized by the Type Approval Authority
test_case: Check the accredited lab data covers the full band and that confirmation tests were done at the highest-emission frequency in each of the 14 bands, all below the limits.

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
quote: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken
condition: Lamp contains active electronics and the 14-band method is used
test_case: Verify the report lists, per band, the maximum reading of both polarizations relative to the limit.
merged: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 8, the narrowband electromagnetic emissions test of the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
quote: If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (e.g. microprocessor/oscillator-based LED driver) generating narrowband emissions
test_case: Review test report to confirm the narrowband emission test was carried out to CISPR 25 unless Annex 8 states otherwise.

text: The narrowband emissions test of the ESA shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions
test_case: Confirm test setup in report follows CISPR 25 clause 6.4 ALSE arrangement (or an OATS compliant with CISPR 16-1-4 as alternative).

text: Where an open area test site (OATS) is used as an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) for the narrowband emissions test of the ESA, the OATS shall comply with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 (see Figure 1 of the appendix to Annex 7).
quote: As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) an open area test site (OATS) which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used
condition: OATS used instead of ALSE as measuring location
test_case: Review test report: if OATS used, verify site validation per CISPR 16-1-4.

text: Ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main narrowband test, and the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation
condition: Lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions
test_case: Check ambient scan in report is at least 6 dB below the paragraph 6.6.2.1 limits across 30-1,000 MHz.

text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions
test_case: Verify the report states an average detector was used for all narrowband readings.

text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Tables 1 and 2 (spectrum analyser: 30 to 1,000 MHz, RBW 100/120 kHz at -3 dB, minimum scan time 100 ms/MHz; scanning receiver: 30 to 1,000 MHz, BW 120 kHz at -6 dB, maximum step size 60 kHz, minimum dwell time 5 ms).
quote: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver. The parameters to be used are defined in Tables 1 and 2.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions
test_case: Check instrument settings in report match Table 1 or Table 2 parameters.

text: Spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments used for conformity measurements shall meet the requirements of CISPR 16-1-1.
quote: Spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments, that meet the requirements of CISPR 16-1-1, may be used for conformity measurements.
condition: Spectrum analyser or FFT-based instrument used for conformity measurements
test_case: Review instrument documentation for CISPR 16-1-1 compliance.

text: In the event that the narrowband limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the ESA.
quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation
condition: Lamp contains active electronics generating narrowband emissions
test_case: Where an exceedance occurs, confirm the report documents investigation distinguishing ESA narrowband emission from background/broadband radiation.

text: Where the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, and the frequency range is divided into the 14 frequency bands (30-34, 34-45, 45-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100-130, 130-170, 170-225, 225-300, 300-400, 400-525, 525-700, 700-850 and 850-1,000 MHz), tests shall be performed at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of Annex 8.
quote: perform tests at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of this Annex
condition: Manufacturer supplies full-band data from ISO 17025 accredited, recognised laboratory and reduced 14-band testing is used
test_case: Verify accredited lab data and that the highest-emission frequency in each of the 14 bands was tested and met the limit.

text: The ESA may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that these result in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered: (a) Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2; (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3; (c) Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4; (d) Stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5; (e) Reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11.
quote: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range
test_case: Review the immunity test plan and reports to confirm that the selected ISO 11452 methods together cover the full 20 to 6,000 MHz range.

text: The frequency range and general test conditions for the immunity tests of the ESA to electromagnetic radiation shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
quote: (Frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1).
test_case: Check the test report to confirm that the frequency range and general test conditions reference ISO 11452-1.

text: The test conditions for the ESA during immunity tests to electromagnetic radiation shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: The test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Audit the test report to confirm that the test conditions (temperature, supply voltage, etc.) are set per ISO 11452-1.

text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
test_case: Verify that the lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) are energised and operating normally during the immunity exposure.

text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
quote: It shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
test_case: Inspect the test set-up photos or drawings against the Annex 9 arrangement requirements.

text: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase.
quote: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase.
test_case: Review the calibration records to confirm that no ESA operating equipment was present during calibration.

text: No extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
quote: No extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
test_case: Check the calibration set-up for at least 1 m clearance from the reference point.

text: To ensure reproducible measurement results, the test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase.
quote: the test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase
test_case: Compare the test and calibration equipment and layout records for identity.

text: If the ESA under test consists of more than one unit, the interconnecting cables should ideally be the wiring harnesses as intended for use in the vehicle; if these are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
quote: If these are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
condition: The lamp ESA consists of more than one unit (e.g. a separate LED driver/ECU)
test_case: Verify that the harness used is the vehicle harness, or that the ECU-to-AN length matches the standard.

text: If the ESA under test consists of more than one unit, all cables in the wiring harness should be terminated as realistically as possible and preferably with real loads and actuators.
quote: All cables in the wiring harness should be terminated as realistically as possible and preferably with real loads and actuators.
condition: The lamp ESA consists of more than one unit (e.g. separate LED driver/ECU) connected by a wiring harness.
test_case: Inspect the test setup and report to confirm that harness cables are terminated with real or realistic loads and actuators.

text: Immunity measurements of the ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Check that the test report covers 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 frequency steps.

text: Unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range
test_case: Verify in the test report that AM 1 kHz, 80 % depth modulation was used from 20 to 400 MHz.

text: Unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
quote: PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range
test_case: Verify in the test report that PM2 modulation (Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs) was used from 2,700 to 3,100 MHz.

text: Unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
quote: PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz
test_case: Verify in the test report that PM3 modulation (Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs) was used from 380 to 2,700 MHz and from 3,100 to 6,000 MHz.

text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Check that the step size and dwell time in the report conform to ISO 11452-1.

text: The immunity test of the ESA shall be performed at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1, throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz, unless a reduced number of spot frequencies is used on the basis of manufacturer data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority.
quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1, throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz.
test_case: Review the test report to confirm frequency coverage 20 to 6,000 MHz at ISO 11452-1 intervals, or accredited ISO 17025 full-band data plus confirmatory spot frequencies.

text: If an ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
quote: it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields
test_case: For any failure, confirm through field monitoring that the failure occurred under controlled test field conditions.

text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
quote: The "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
condition: The absorber chamber test (ISO 11452-2) is selected
test_case: Verify that the absorber chamber report states field calibration by the substitution method per ISO 11452-2.

text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
quote: The test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
condition: The absorber chamber test (ISO 11452-2) is selected
test_case: Confirm in the report that vertical antenna polarization was used.

text: When TEM cell testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
condition: TEM cell testing is selected
test_case: Check that the TEM cell test report references and follows ISO 11452-3.
merged: When stripline testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.

text: When TEM cell testing is used, the method of maximum field coupling to the ESA or to the wiring harness inside the TEM-cell shall be chosen depending on the ESA to be tested.
quote: Depending on the ESA to be tested the Technical Service shall chose the method of maximum field coupling to the ESA or to the wiring harness inside the TEM-cell.
condition: TEM cell testing is selected as one of the test methods.
test_case: Check the TEM cell test report documents the chosen coupling (ESA or harness) giving maximum field coupling.

text: When bulk current injection testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench, either with the BCI substitution method and the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or with the BCI closed loop method and the injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method
condition: Bulk current injection testing is selected
test_case: Verify the BCI report for an ISO 11452-4 bench set-up with the probe at 150 mm (substitution method) or 900 mm (closed loop method).

text: When bulk current injection testing is performed with the ESA installed in the vehicle as an alternative, it shall be performed according to ISO 11451-4 with the BCI substitution method and the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
quote: the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method
condition: BCI testing is performed in-vehicle
test_case: Verify the in-vehicle BCI report for ISO 11451-4 with the substitution method and the probe at 150 mm.

text: When the reverberation chamber test is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
condition: The reverberation chamber test is selected
test_case: Check that the reverberation chamber test report follows ISO 11452-11.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
quote: Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
condition: The reverberation chamber test is selected
test_case: Inspect the reverberation chamber set-up for the presence of a ground plane.

text: The test method shall ensure the immunity of the ESA (rear combination lamp) to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
quote: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control circuitry) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Perform conducted transient immunity tests per Annex 10 and confirm the lamp functions remain within the required functional status.

text: The test method shall limit conducted transients from the ESA (rear combination lamp) to the vehicle power supply.
quote: limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control circuitry) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Measure conducted transient emissions per Annex 10 and confirm they are within the regulation limits.

text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control circuitry) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to all supply and operationally connected lines and verify the required FPSC is achieved.

text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs
condition: The lamp contains active electronics and may be installed on vehicles with a 12V/24V starter motor
test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the supply and operationally connected lines and verify the required functional status class is achieved.

text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control circuitry) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Measure transient conducted emissions per ISO 7637-2 on supply and operationally connected lines and compare against the regulation limits.

text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10.
test_case: Inspect the lamp mounting and verify after vibration/normal use that photometric and installation characteristics remain within prescribed limits.

text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
test_case: Inspect the mounting and fixings to confirm the lamp cannot be shifted out of its intended orientation without deliberate action.

text: For all light-signalling devices, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
quote: the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road
test_case: Measure the angle between the lamp reference axis and the road bearing plane on the vehicle; pass if within ±3°.

text: For the rear light-signalling devices (other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps), the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
quote: parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices. In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.
test_case: Measure the angle between the lamp reference axis and the vehicle median longitudinal plane; pass if within ±3°.

text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of the light-signalling devices laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
test_case: Compare the installed lamp against the manufacturer's fitting instructions; pass if all instructions are met.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
quote: the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface
test_case: Measure lamp height and orientation with the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface and confirm compliance.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface).
quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp
test_case: Measure the lateral positions of the left and right lamps relative to the median longitudinal plane; pass if symmetrical.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
quote: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp
test_case: Compare the external geometry of the left and right hand lamps; pass if mirror-symmetrical about the median plane.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
test_case: Measure chromaticity of each function on left and right lamps; pass if both meet the same colour requirements.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except for a matched pair of a function.
quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
test_case: Compare photometric measurements of left and right lamps; pass if substantially identical.

text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle, and all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
quote: only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle
condition: Lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo
test_case: Inspect the rear lamps for logos; pass if at most one per side or one central and only vehicle/body manufacturer logos.

text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the pair requirements of paragraph 5.5. shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
quote: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the above requirements shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
condition: Target vehicle has an asymmetrical external shape
test_case: Review the installation on the asymmetrical vehicle to confirm pair symmetry is achieved as far as possible.

text: Where lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, shall be fulfilled.
quote: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections
test_case: Verify each function in the combination lamp individually against its colour, position, orientation, visibility and electrical connection requirements.

text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped
test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with all other functions of the lamp switched off; pass if within limits.

text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamps are switched ON.
quote: the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON
condition: Rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp or another function
test_case: Switch on the rear position lamp together with the reciprocally incorporated function and measure colour; pass if the other function's colour requirements are met.

text: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps shall not be reciprocally incorporated.
quote: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are not permitted to be reciprocally incorporated.
condition: Lamp integrates a direction-indicator function
test_case: Inspect the lamp design to confirm the stop lamp does not share a light-emitting surface/source with a direction indicator.

text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, any horizontal or vertical straight line passing through the projections of the apparent surfaces of these functions on a plane perpendicular to the reference axis shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour.
quote: shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour
condition: Lamp groups a stop lamp with a direction-indicator lamp
test_case: Check projected apparent surfaces with horizontal/vertical lines; pass if no line crosses more than two colour borderlines.

text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, shall not overlap.
quote: Their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, do not overlap.
condition: Lamp groups a stop lamp with a direction-indicator lamp
test_case: Project apparent surfaces along the reference axis; pass if the stop and direction-indicator surfaces do not overlap.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing that projection, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis; this does not apply to a single retro-reflector.
quote: shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis
condition: A lamp function has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts
test_case: Measure projected apparent surface parts; pass if area ratio ≥ 60 % of circumscribing quadrilateral or gap between parts ≤ 75 mm.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing those projections, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
quote: composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that
condition: A function is realised by two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro-reflectors (e.g. split body/tailgate)
test_case: Measure the projected apparent surfaces of the two units; pass if ≥ 60 % area ratio or facing-edge distance ≤ 75 mm.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) (interdependent lamp system) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
condition: A function is realised as an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Apply the 60 % / 75 mm checks of paragraph 5.7.2.1 to the interdependent lamp system.

text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens, these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system, except that a lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.
quote: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens these shall not be considered
condition: Lamp is claimed as part of an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Review the lamp classification; pass if separate surfaces in one body/common lens are not declared as an interdependent system unless band/strip-shaped.

text: For two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip, the illumination of such a surface shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends.
quote: the illumination of such a surface shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends
condition: The lamp includes a function in the shape of a band or strip (e.g. the elongated upper channel) installed as an interdependent/single lamp arrangement
test_case: Inspect the band/strip lamp and confirm at least two light sources are located as close as possible to its ends.

text: For lamps in the shape of a band or strip whose light-emitting surface is constituted by a number of juxtaposed elements, these individual light-emitting surfaces, when projected on a transverse plane, shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
quote: the light-emitting surface may be constituted by a number of juxtaposed elements on condition that these individual light-emitting surfaces, when projected on a transverse plane fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
condition: The band or strip lamp light-emitting surface is made of juxtaposed elements
test_case: Project the juxtaposed light-emitting elements on a transverse plane and verify the 60 per cent area or 75 mm gap criterion of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, and not less than 0.8 m long; the illumination shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends, and juxtaposed light-emitting elements, when projected on a transverse plane, shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
quote: extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, and are not less than 0.8 m long
condition: A function is realised as a band- or strip-shaped lamp counted as a pair
test_case: Measure strip length, distance to vehicle outer edge and light source positions; pass if ≥ 0.8 m long, within 0.4 m of the outer edge and ≥ 2 light sources near the ends.

text: Red light emitted by the rear position lamp, the stop lamp and the rear retro-reflector fitted on the rear of the vehicle shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
test_case: Check on the vehicle that no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front.

text: The maximum height above the ground of the lamps shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface
test_case: Measure the highest and lowest points of each function's apparent surface above ground on the vehicle and compare with height limits.

text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
quote: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.
test_case: Where reduced vertical visibility angles are used, measure the lamp height from the H plane and confirm the reduction condition is met.

text: The position of the lamps, as regards width, shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width, and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps.
quote: The position, as regards width, will be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest
test_case: Measure lateral position on the vehicle from the outer and inner edges of the apparent surface and check against the individual specifications.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
quote: the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON
test_case: Operate each function and verify intensity, colour and apparent surface remain constant while switched ON.

text: Where the photometric characteristics of the lamp vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
quote: provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned
condition: The lamp uses variable intensity or shares light sources between functions (e.g. reciprocally incorporated position/stop lamp).
test_case: Measure photometry in each varying state and confirm all values stay within the device approval limits.

text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
quote: there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front
test_case: Observe from Zone 1 at 25 m in front of the vehicle per Annex 4; no red apparent surface shall be directly visible.

text: In case of doubt, the requirement on visibility of red light towards the front shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
quote: is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable
test_case: Measure luminous intensity of red light emitted forward; pass if ≤ 0.25 cd per lamp.

text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously, except while the conditions listed in paragraph 5.11.1. exist (parking lamps, side-marker lamps flashing with direction indicators, daytime running lamps switched ON, front position lamps substituted under paragraph 5.12.1.).
quote: the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously
test_case: Operate the lighting switch on the vehicle and verify the rear position lamps switch ON/OFF together with front position and registration plate lamps.

text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
condition: The rear lamp forms part of an interdependent lamp system (e.g. split body/tailgate lamps marked 'Y').
test_case: Switch the function and verify all light sources of the interdependent system light and extinguish simultaneously.

text: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. (including the rear position lamps) are also switched ON, except for main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps used for luminous warnings by intermittent or alternate lighting up at short intervals.
quote: cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON
test_case: On the vehicle, switch on dipped/main beam and front fog lamps and verify the rear position lamps are ON whenever any of them is ON, except during flashing luminous warnings.

text: The concealment of the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall be prohibited.
quote: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps
test_case: Inspect the installation to confirm the rear lamp functions are not concealable.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
quote: Reversing lamp: White
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the reversing lamp and confirm it is within the white limits.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
quote: Stop lamp: Red
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the stop lamp and confirm it is within the red limits.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
quote: Rear position lamp: Red
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the rear position lamp and confirm it is within the red limits.

text: The colour of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red
test_case: Measure colour of the retro-reflected light and confirm it is red.
