text: The number of rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
test_case: Count the installed lamps per function and compare with paragraph 6 individual specifications.

text: The lamp may be installed on movable components only provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
condition: The lamp (or part of it) is mounted on a movable component such as a tailgate or boot lid.
test_case: Verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18 to 5.20 for any lamp mounted on a movable component.

text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
quote: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements
condition: Rear position lamp or retro-reflector is mounted on a movable component.
test_case: Check position, visibility angles, colour and photometry at each fixed position of the movable component.

text: Where the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector functions on movable components are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", at least one of the lamps shall meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
quote: only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components
condition: The function is obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked 'D' with one on a movable component.
test_case: Verify at all fixed positions that at least one 'D' lamp meets position, visibility and photometric requirements.

text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors may be installed on movable components only where additional lamps for these functions are fitted and switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
quote: Where additional lamps for the above functions are fitted and are switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position
condition: Rear position lamp/retro-reflector on a movable component relying on additional lamps when open.
test_case: Open the movable component and verify additional lamps switch ON and meet position, visibility and photometric requirements.

text: Where the rear position lamp function is obtained by an interdependent lamp system completely mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied, or additional lamps switched ON in any fixed open position shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
quote: Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied.
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system fully mounted on a movable component.
test_case: Verify 5.18.1 compliance at all fixed positions or compliance of additional lamps when open.

text: Where the rear position lamp function is obtained by an interdependent lamp system partly mounted on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s); the inwards geometric visibility is deemed satisfied if they still conform to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution.
quote: the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system split between body and tailgate/boot lid.
test_case: At all fixed positions of the movable component, verify the specified lamp(s) meet position, outward visibility, colour and photometry.

text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
quote: the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users
condition: The lamp is mounted on a movable component.
test_case: Assess with the movable component open that the lamps do not cause glare or confusion to road users.

text: When the lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
quote: the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation
condition: The lamp is mounted on a movable component.
test_case: Cycle the movable component and verify the lamp returns to the specified position.

text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
quote: shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position
test_case: With movable components in each fixed open position, measure the obscured portion of the apparent surface; pass if ≤ 50 %.

text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON
condition: The apparent surface of the rear position lamp/retro-reflector can be more than 50 % hidden by a movable component.
test_case: Open the movable component and verify the additional lamps switch ON and meet all requirements.

text: Where more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface of the lamp in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road; this does not apply to retro-reflectors (paragraph 5.21.3.).
quote: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned
condition: Lamp (or part of it) is mounted on a movable component such as a tailgate or boot lid and more than 50 % of its apparent surface can be hidden
test_case: Inspect the vehicle documentation and interior for the required user notice when the movable component hides more than 50 % of the apparent surface.

text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
quote: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate
test_case: Check on the vehicle that the rear position, stop and reversing lamps operate once light source and/or fuse are installed, without further wiring.

text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
quote: shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 37
test_case: Perform a light source replacement on the installed lamp using only vehicle-supplied tools and verify it can be done without expert assistance.

text: For lamps approved with replaceable light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, the vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 37
test_case: Check the vehicle documentation contains a detailed light source replacement procedure.

text: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23.
quote: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37
condition: Light source module includes a holder for an R37 replaceable light source
test_case: Verify the R37 light source in the module can be replaced per paragraph 5.23 without expert assistance or special tools.

text: A temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed only provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
quote: provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate
condition: Lamp provides a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function
test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure and verify the replacement function has similar colour, main intensity and position.

text: In case of a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
quote: provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function
condition: Lamp provides a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function
test_case: During simulated failure, verify the replacement device still performs its original function correctly.

text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
condition: Lamp provides a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function
test_case: Simulate failure and verify the dashboard tell-tale indicates temporary replacement and need for repair.

text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, the intensity of all such lamps, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
quote: The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 and/or stop lamp is category S2 with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Vary the controlling conditions and measure intensities of R2/S2 lamps to confirm they vary together in similar proportion.

text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
quote: In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 and/or stop lamp is category S2 with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Measure stop/position lamp intensity ratio across the full variation range and transitions and confirm the prescribed ratio is maintained.

text: For R2 rear position lamps and S2 stop lamps with variable luminous intensity control, increase and decrease of the luminous intensity in relation to environmental conditions (ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds, contamination of the light emitting surface) shall be within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations.
quote: Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed in relation to the following conditions
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 and/or stop lamp is category S2 with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Verify intensity variation under the listed environmental conditions stays within the R148 limits.

text: For R2 rear position lamps and S2 stop lamps with variable luminous intensity control, a decrease of the luminous intensity due to traffic conditions, within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, shall only be activated when the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m, and an already activated decrease may remain active only as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h.
quote: a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 and/or stop lamp is category S2 with variable luminous intensity control responding to traffic conditions
test_case: Test intensity decrease activation at speeds/following distances around 20 km/h, 20 m and 50 km/h and verify correct behaviour.

text: Stop lamps of category S4 may produce variable luminous intensity, based on the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., independently from the other lamps.
quote: Stop lamps of category S4 and rear fog lamps of category F2 may produce variable luminous intensity
condition: Stop lamp is category S4
test_case: Verify S4 stop lamp variable intensity follows the conditions of 5.26.1 and 5.26.2.

text: For lamps with variable luminous intensity, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
quote: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
condition: Rear position lamp and/or stop lamp has variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Record intensity during transitions and verify there is no sharp step change.

text: For vehicles of M and N categories, the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. shall comply with the provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant.
quote: the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. above comply
condition: Applies unless the lamp includes electronic light source control gear, an integral variable intensity control, or only R128 light sources (paragraph 5.27.3.)
test_case: Review the applicant's demonstration of the supply voltage at the lamp terminals under constant voltage operation; pass if it complies with 5.27.1./5.27.2.

text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
quote: shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved
condition: Lamp was approved with a special power supply, secondary operating mode or applicant-requested voltage, and is not exempted by paragraph 5.27.3.
test_case: Measure the voltage at the lamp terminals on the vehicle in constant voltage condition; pass if it does not exceed the voltage stated in the device approval.

text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
quote: the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V
condition: Lamp does not include electronic light source control gear, an integral variable intensity control, or only R128 light sources (paragraph 5.27.3.)
test_case: Measure terminal voltage of each lamp function on the vehicle; pass if not above 13.5 V +3 % (12 V system) or 28 V +3 % (24 V system).

text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
quote: shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device
condition: Presence of LED driver/electronic control gear, integral variable intensity control or R128-only light sources not stated
test_case: Check the lamp approval documentation for electronic control gear, integral variable intensity control or R128 light sources to determine whether 5.27.1./5.27.2. apply.

text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except obstacles already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface
test_case: Check on the vehicle that no part of the vehicle obstructs light from the apparent surface within the prescribed geometric visibility angles.

text: If measurements of geometric visibility are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
test_case: Review geometric visibility measurement method to confirm parallel shift of observation direction when measuring near the lamp.

text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
quote: proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device
test_case: Where vehicle parts hide part of the apparent surface, measure photometry of the unobstructed part and confirm it meets device approval values.

text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal is reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
quote: the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal
condition: Lamp mounted less than 750 mm above the ground with reduced vertical geometric visibility
test_case: Confirm mounting height below 750 mm before applying reduced 5° photometric field below horizontal.

text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
condition: Lamp function is realised as an interdependent lamp system (e.g. split between body and tailgate)
test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify geometric visibility angles are met.

text: A LED module may be non-replaceable only if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
quote: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
condition: Lamp uses non-replaceable LED module(s)
test_case: Check the R148 communication sheet states the LED module is non-replaceable.

text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6
test_case: Verify the rear position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflector carry valid R148/R150 type approvals and markings.

text: In case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148
condition: Lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo
test_case: Check R148 approval documentation covers the lamp including the logo.

text: Lamps installed on a vehicle approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128 shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only; this does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
quote: shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only
condition: Lamp is approved for replaceable light source categories according to R37, R99 or R128
test_case: Inspect fitted light sources and confirm they are approved in the categories stated in the lamp approval.

text: Lamps equipped with LED substitute light source(s) shall be used only where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive, and the presence of the marking on the lamps related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked at type approval and conformity of production.
quote: The use of lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s), is allowed exclusively in the case where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive.
condition: Lamp is approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s)
test_case: Check the vehicle statement per 3.2.8 is positive and the lamp bears the LED substitute light source marking.

text: The reversing lamp shall be present on motor vehicles (mandatory).
quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm at least one reversing lamp is fitted.

text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device is mandatory and a second device is optional.
quote: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1
test_case: Count the reversing lamps installed on the M1 vehicle; pass if one or two are fitted.

text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23
test_case: Check the reversing lamp carries a valid R23 or R148 approval mark and approval certificate.

text: In height, the reversing lamp shall be positioned not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
test_case: Measure the apparent surface height on the unladen vehicle; pass if between 250 mm and 1,200 mm.

text: In length, the reversing lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle
test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm the reversing lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.
merged: In length, the rear position lamps shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.

text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angle α as specified in paragraph 2.10.7. shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
quote: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the apparent surface is visible over 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
merged: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, if there are two devices, the geometric visibility defined by angle β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7. shall be β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards.

text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, if there is only one device, the geometric visibility defined by angle β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7. shall be β = 45° to right and to left.
quote: β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device
condition: Only one reversing lamp fitted on the vehicle
test_case: Verify visibility of the apparent surface over 45° to the right and left of the single device.

text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
quote: Orientation Rearwards
test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm the reference axis of the reversing lamp points rearwards.

text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged
test_case: Functional test: lamp lights only with reverse gear engaged and propulsion system operable.

text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position in which operation of the propulsion system is possible.
quote: It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.
test_case: Disengage reverse gear or switch off propulsion system and confirm the lamp switches OFF and cannot be switched ON.

text: For the reversing lamp, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
quote: Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
condition: Component regulation (R23/R148) requires failure indication for the lamp's light source configuration
test_case: Check the component approval; if failure indication is required, simulate failure and confirm the tell-tale activates.
merged: For stop lamps, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.

text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles (including M1).
quote: Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm that S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices are fitted.

text: Stop lamp devices of S3 or S4 category shall be mandatory on M1 category vehicles.
quote: Devices of S3 or S4 category: mandatory on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles
test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle and confirm that an S3 or S4 category stop lamp is fitted in addition to the rear combination lamps.

text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices and one S3 or S4 category device shall be installed on all categories of vehicles.
quote: Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
test_case: Count the stop lamps on the vehicle and confirm two S1/S2 devices (left and right rear combination lamps) and one S3/S4 device.

text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00
test_case: Check the approval mark and certificate of the stop lamp for an R7 (02 series or later) or R148 (00 series or later) approval.
merged: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

text: For M1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories stop lamps, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamps, the height above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
quote: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm
test_case: Measure the stop lamp apparent surface height above ground per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

text: If optional S1 or S2 category stop lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps
condition: Optional S1/S2 stop lamps are installed
test_case: Measure vertical distance between optional and mandatory stop lamps; pass if ≥ 600 mm and width/symmetry requirements are met.

text: The horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of an S3 or S4 category device shall be above the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of the S1 or S2 categories stop lamps.
quote: the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of a S3 or S4 category device shall be above the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge
condition: An S3 or S4 category high-mounted stop lamp is installed on the vehicle together with this S1/S2 stop lamp.
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the upper edge of the S1/S2 stop lamp apparent surface and the lower edge of the S3/S4 apparent surface; pass if the S3/S4 lower edge is higher.

text: In length, S1 or S2 categories stop lamps shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation; pass if the stop lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: The geometric visibility horizontal angle for S1 or S2 categories stop lamps shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
quote: Horizontal angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
test_case: Verify on the installed lamp that the apparent surface is visible over 45° left and right; pass if unobstructed over the full angle.

text: The geometric visibility vertical angle for S1 or S2 categories stop lamps shall be 15° above and below the horizontal.
quote: Vertical angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 15° above and below the horizontal.
test_case: Verify on the installed lamp visibility of the apparent surface over 15° up and down; pass if unobstructed.

text: For stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
quote: for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20°
condition: Stop lamp mounted below 750 mm
test_case: Measure mounting height; if below 750 mm verify inward visibility of at least 20° under the H plane.

text: Where an S1 or S2 category stop lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°
condition: Stop lamp mounted below 750 mm
test_case: Measure mounting height; if below 750 mm verify downward visibility of at least 5°.
merged: Where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
Where an optional S1 or S2 category stop lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the upward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
quote: Orientation Towards the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if the stop lamp reference axis points rearwards.

text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
quote: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
test_case: Apply the braking signal on the vehicle; pass if all stop lamps switch ON simultaneously.

text: The stop lamps need not function only if the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
quote: The stop lamps need not function if the device, which starts and/or stops the propulsion system, is in a position that makes it impossible
test_case: Check stop lamp operation with the ignition/start device in each position; pass if stop lamps function whenever the propulsion system can operate.

text: Rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatory.
quote: Presence Devices of R or R1 or R2 categories: Mandatory
test_case: Inspect the vehicle; pass if rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted.

text: In width, that point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm
test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the rear position lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: In height, the rear position lamps shall be above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible
test_case: Measure the rear position lamp apparent surface height per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

text: If optional rear position lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1.
condition: Optional rear position lamps are installed (paragraph 6.10.2.1 permits these only for M2, M3, N2, N3, O2, O3 and O4, not M1).
test_case: Measure the heights of the mandatory and optional rear position lamps on the vehicle; pass if the optional lamps are at least 600 mm above the mandatory lamps and respect width and symmetry.

text: The geometric visibility horizontal angle for the rear position lamps shall be 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
test_case: Verify on the installed lamp visibility of the apparent surface over 45° inwards and 80° outwards; pass if unobstructed.

text: The geometric visibility vertical angle for the rear position lamps shall be 15° above and below the horizontal.
quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.
test_case: Verify on the installed lamp visibility over 15° up and down; pass if unobstructed.

text: Where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
quote: where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane
condition: Rear position lamp mounted below 750 mm
test_case: Measure mounting height; if below 750 mm verify inward visibility of at least 20° under the H plane.

text: Where an optional rear position lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the upward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
condition: An optional rear position lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (not expected on M1).
test_case: Measure the mounting height and check geometric visibility; pass if the lamp is visible at least 5° upward when mounted above 2,100 mm.

text: To be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.
condition: Manufacturer chooses alternative visibility per 6.10.5.2
test_case: Measure unobstructed apparent surface (excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector area) in the visibility directions; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

text: For M1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the horizontal angle of the rear position lamp shall be 45° outwards to 45° inwards, with the inward angle reducible to 20° under the H plane where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm.
quote: only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards.
condition: Manufacturer chooses alternative visibility and a rear side-marker lamp is installed
test_case: Confirm rear side-marker lamp is fitted and verify visibility over 45° outwards to 45° inwards.

text: For M1 category vehicles using the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., the vertical angle of the rear position lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, with the downward angle reducible to 5° where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm.
quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm
condition: Manufacturer chooses alternative visibility and a rear side-marker lamp is installed
test_case: Verify vertical visibility over 15° up and down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

text: The rear position lamps shall be oriented rearwards.
quote: Orientation Rearwards.
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if the rear position lamp reference axis points rearwards.

text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
quote: Electrical connections In accordance with paragraph 5.11.
test_case: Check the wiring and switching of the rear position lamps against paragraph 5.11; pass if compliant.

text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps is mandatory.
quote: Tell-tale. Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.
test_case: Switch on the rear position lamps on the vehicle and verify that a closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates.

text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamps shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
quote: It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps. This requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
test_case: Check on the vehicle that the same tell-tale indicates operation of both the front and rear position lamps.

text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamps is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
quote: However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
condition: Component Regulation requires a failure tell-tale for the rear position lamp (e.g. electronic light source control/failure monitoring)
test_case: Simulate a failure of the rear position lamp and verify that the failure tell-tale is activated where required by the component Regulation.

text: In all cases, the distance between the rear fog-lamp and each stop-lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.
quote: In all cases, the distance between the rear fog-lamp and each stop-lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the distance between the rear fog lamp and each stop lamp of the rear lamp; pass if greater than 100 mm.

text: Where the parking lamp function is performed by the front and rear position lamps according to paragraph 6.12.9., the rear position lamps shall be able to operate even if the device which starts the propulsion system is in a position which makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate, and a device which automatically switches OFF these lamps as a function of time is prohibited.
quote: if applicable, the front and rear position lamps according to paragraph 6.12.9. below, shall be able to operate even if the device which starts the propulsion system
condition: Parking lamp function is performed by simultaneously switching ON the front and rear position lamps on the same side
test_case: With the propulsion system disabled, switch on the parking function and verify the rear position lamps operate and are not switched off automatically after a time.

text: Where the parking lamp function is performed by simultaneously switching ON the front and rear position lamps on the same side of the vehicle according to paragraph 6.12.9., the connection shall allow the rear position lamp(s) on the same side of the vehicle to be switched ON independently of any other lamps.
quote: The connection shall allow the parking lamp(s) on the same side of the vehicle to be switched ON independently of any other lamps.
condition: Parking lamp function is performed by the front and rear position lamps (paragraph 6.12.9.)
test_case: On the vehicle, activate the parking lamp control for each side and verify that only the position lamps of that side switch ON, independently of other lamps.

text: If an end-outline marker lamp tell-tale exists, its function shall be carried out by the tell-tale required for the front and rear position lamps.
quote: If it exists, its function shall be carried out by the tell-tale required for the front and rear position lamps.
condition: Vehicle is fitted with end-outline marker lamps having a tell-tale
test_case: Inspect the vehicle tell-tale circuitry and verify that the end-outline marker lamp tell-tale is the same as the front and rear position lamp tell-tale.

text: The position of an end-outline marker lamp in relation to the corresponding rear position lamp shall be such that the distance between the projections on a transverse vertical plane of the points nearest to one another on the apparent surfaces in the direction of the respective reference axes of the two lamps considered is not less than 200 mm.
quote: The position of an end-outline marker lamp in relation to corresponding position lamp shall be such that the distance between the projections
condition: Vehicle is fitted with rear end-outline marker lamps
test_case: Measure the projected distance on a transverse vertical plane between the nearest points of the apparent surfaces of the end-outline marker lamp and the rear position lamp; pass if not less than 200 mm.

text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, is mandatory on motor vehicles.
quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles.
test_case: Verify that the M1 vehicle is fitted with non-triangular rear retro-reflectors.

text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
quote: Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3
test_case: Check that two rear retro-reflectors are fitted and carry a Class IA or IB approval mark under UN R3 (02 series or later) or UN R150 (00 series or later).

text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) are permitted only provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
quote: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below), are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness
condition: Additional retro-reflecting devices or materials are fitted
test_case: Inspect any additional retro-reflecting devices and verify they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.

text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if not more than 400 mm.

text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
quote: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s)
test_case: Measure the height of the retro-reflector above ground per paragraph 5.8.1.; pass if between 250 mm and 900 mm (1,200 mm if grouped with rear lamps, 1,500 mm where bodywork prevents).

text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect the vehicle and verify the retro-reflector is located at the rear.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
quote: Geometric visibility Horizontal angle: 30° inwards and outwards.
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the retro-reflector illuminating surface is visible over 30° inwards and outwards horizontally.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal; however, where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the retro-reflector is visible 10° above and 10° below the horizontal (5° below if mounted below 750 mm).

text: The orientation of the rear retro-reflector shall be rearwards.
quote: Orientation Rearwards.
test_case: Inspect the installation and verify the retro-reflector reference axis faces rearwards.

text: The rear retro-reflector, triangular, is prohibited on motor vehicles; the rear retro-reflector of the lamp shall therefore not be triangular.
quote: Presence Mandatory on trailers. Prohibited on motor vehicles.
test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector shape and verify it is not triangular.

text: On M1 category vehicles less than 6 m in length, side-marker lamps shall be used if they supplement the reduced geometric visibility requirements of rear position lamps conforming to paragraph 6.10.5.2.
quote: on M1 and N1 category vehicles less than 6 m in length, side-marker lamps shall be used, if they supplement the reduced geometric visibility requirements
condition: The rear position lamp is installed with the reduced geometric visibility allowed by paragraph 6.10.5.2.
test_case: Check the vehicle installation: if the rear position lamp uses the reduced visibility angles of 6.10.5.2., verify that side-marker lamps are fitted to supplement them.

text: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON.
quote: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON.
test_case: On the vehicle, activate the daytime running lamps and verify by inspection that the rear position lamps of the rear lamp are switched ON.

text: The rear position lamps may be switched OFF when the daytime running lamps are switched ON only as long as the ambient light conditions outside the vehicle are above 7,000 lux (measured according to the requirements of Annex 13).
quote: may remain switched OFF as long as the ambient light conditions outside vehicle are above 7,000 lux (measured according to the requirements of Annex 13).
condition: Vehicle switches the rear position lamps OFF while daytime running lamps are ON depending on ambient light.
test_case: With DRL ON, vary ambient light per Annex 13 and verify the rear position lamps stay OFF only when ambient light exceeds 7,000 lux and switch ON otherwise.

text: Conspicuity markings are prohibited on vehicles of category M1; the rear lamp installed on an M1 vehicle shall not incorporate or be supplemented by conspicuity markings.
quote: Prohibited: on vehicles of categories M1 and O1.
test_case: Inspect the rear lamp and its M1 vehicle installation; pass if no conspicuity marking material is fitted.

text: Where the emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps, the emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
condition: The vehicle uses the stop lamps (rather than the direction-indicator lamps) to give the emergency stop signal.
test_case: Trigger the emergency stop signal on the vehicle and check that all fitted stop lamps operate simultaneously.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be present (mandatory) on motor vehicles; where the stop lamps of the rear lamp are used, the emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop lamps fitted.
quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles. Optional on trailers. The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps
condition: Emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps of this rear lamp rather than by direction-indicator lamps
test_case: Check the vehicle installation for an emergency stop signal function and verify that all stop lamps operate simultaneously when it is triggered.

text: Where the emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps, the number of lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.2. or 6.7.2.
quote: Number As specified in paragraph 6.5.2. or 6.7.2.
condition: The vehicle uses the stop lamps to give the emergency stop signal.
test_case: Count the stop lamps used for the emergency stop signal and compare against paragraph 6.7.2.
merged: Where the emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps, the position of the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.4. or 6.7.4.
Where the emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps, the geometric visibility of the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.5. or 6.7.5.
Where the emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps, the arrangement of the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.3. or 6.7.3.
Where the emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps, the orientation of the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.6. or 6.7.6.

text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
quote: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
condition: The vehicle uses the stop lamps to give the emergency stop signal.
test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal and measure the flash frequency and phase of all stop lamps; pass if they are in phase at 3.0-5.0 Hz.

text: If any of the lamps of the emergency stop signal to the rear of the vehicle use filament light sources, the frequency of the emergency stop signal shall be 4.0 +0.0/-1.0 Hz.
quote: if any of the lamps of the emergency stop signal to the rear of the vehicle use filament light sources the frequency shall be 4.0 +0.0/-1.0 Hz.
condition: Any rear lamp of the emergency stop signal uses filament light sources (the product is stated as LED).
test_case: Where filament light sources are used, measure the flash frequency; pass if it is between 3.0 and 4.0 Hz.

text: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
condition: The vehicle uses the stop lamps to give the emergency stop signal.
test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal with the other lamps in various states and check that its operation is unaffected.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
condition: The vehicle uses the stop lamps to give the emergency stop signal.
test_case: Check that no manual control exists and that the signal is switched ON and OFF automatically.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal
condition: The vehicle uses the stop lamps to give the emergency stop signal.
test_case: Perform braking tests above and below 50 km/h, with and without the emergency braking logic signal; pass if activation occurs only above 50 km/h with the signal present.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided
condition: The vehicle uses the stop lamps to give the emergency stop signal.
test_case: Remove the emergency braking logic signal, or activate the hazard warning signal, and check that the emergency stop signal switches OFF automatically.

text: If a motor vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer, the control of the emergency stop signal on the motor vehicle shall also be capable of operating the emergency stop signal on the trailer, except as provided in paragraph 6.23.9.2.
quote: if a motor vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer, the control of the emergency stop signal on the motor vehicle shall also be capable of operating
condition: The M1 vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer and uses the stop lamps for the emergency stop signal.
test_case: With a trailer connected, trigger the emergency stop signal and check that the trailer signal operates.

text: When the motor vehicle is electrically connected to a trailer, the operating frequency of the emergency stop signal for the combination shall be limited to the frequency specified in paragraph 6.23.7.1.1., unless the motor vehicle can detect that filament light sources are not being used on the trailer for the emergency stop signal.
quote: When the motor vehicle is electrically connected to a trailer, the operating frequency of the emergency stop signal for the combination shall be limited
condition: The M1 vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer and uses the stop lamps for the emergency stop signal.
test_case: With a trailer connected, measure the flash frequency; pass if it is within 4.0 +0.0/-1.0 Hz, unless filament-free trailer detection is demonstrated.

text: If a motor vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer fitted with a service braking system of either continuous or semi-continuous type, it shall be ensured that a constant power supply is provided via the electrical connector for the stop lamps to such trailers while the service brake is applied.
quote: it shall be ensured that a constant power supply is provided via the electrical connector for the stop lamps to such trailers while the service brake is applied.
condition: The M1 vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer with a continuous or semi-continuous service braking system.
test_case: Apply the service brake and measure the trailer connector stop-lamp pin; pass if a constant supply is present.

text: Where the rear position lamps are switched ON as exterior courtesy lamps, the rear position lamps shall not be switched ON as exterior courtesy lamps unless the vehicle is stationary and the propulsion system is stopped, or a driver or passenger door or a load compartment door is opened or after being closed.
quote: The exterior courtesy lamp(s) shall not be switched ON unless the vehicle is stationary and one or more of the following conditions is satisfied
condition: Rear position lamps are used as exterior courtesy lamps
test_case: Functional vehicle test: verify that courtesy activation of the rear position lamps occurs only when stationary with propulsion stopped or a door opened or recently closed.

text: Where the rear position lamps are switched ON as exterior courtesy lamps, the rear position lamps operating as exterior courtesy lamps shall be switched OFF when the vehicle is no longer stationary.
quote: However, the exterior courtesy lamp(s) shall be switched OFF when the vehicle is no longer stationary.
condition: Rear position lamps are used as exterior courtesy lamps
test_case: Functional vehicle test: start moving the vehicle during courtesy mode and verify that the courtesy activation switches OFF.

text: Where the rear position lamps are switched ON as exterior courtesy lamps and vary in luminous intensity and/or apparent surface, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
quote: The exterior courtesy lamp or lamps may vary in luminous intensity and/or vary in apparent surface. No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
condition: Rear position lamps are used as exterior courtesy lamps with variable intensity or apparent surface
test_case: Observe or measure intensity during courtesy-mode transitions and verify that there is no abrupt change.

text: Where the rear position lamps are switched ON as exterior courtesy lamps, the rear position lamps operating as exterior courtesy lamps shall not flash.
quote: The exterior courtesy lamp(s) shall not flash.
condition: Rear position lamps are used as exterior courtesy lamps
test_case: Observe the courtesy mode operation and verify a steady (non-flashing) light output.

text: Reversing lamps shall not be switched ON as exterior courtesy lamp(s); approved lamps emitting white light, with the exception of main beam head lamps, daytime running lamps and reversing lamps, and rear position lamps may be switched ON as exterior courtesy lamp(s).
quote: Approved lamps emitting white light with the exception of main beam head lamps, daytime running lamps and reversing lamps may be switched ON as exterior courtesy lamp(s).
condition: The vehicle uses lamps of this rear combination lamp in the exterior courtesy function.
test_case: Check the vehicle courtesy-lighting logic and confirm that the reversing lamp is never activated as an exterior courtesy lamp.

text: If a lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the number of lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used, but it may be less than or equal to that number.
quote: In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal. However, the number may be less than
condition: A lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal
test_case: Check the number of lamps used for the answer-back signal does not exceed the number permitted by the individual specification of that lamp.

text: If a lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the arrangement of the lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used.
quote: Arrangement In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
condition: A lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal
test_case: Inspect the installation and verify the arrangement meets the individual specification of the lamp used.
merged: If a lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the position in height of the lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used.

If a lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the position in length of the lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used.

If a lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the orientation of the lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used.

text: If a lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the position in width of the lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used.
quote: In width: In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
condition: A lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal
test_case: Measure the lateral position on the vehicle and compare against the individual specification of the lamp used.

text: If a lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the geometric visibility of the lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used, although it may be reduced in comparison to those specifications.
quote: Geometric visibility In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal. However, the geometric visibility may be reduced
condition: A lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal
test_case: Check the geometric visibility angles do not exceed those of the individual specification of the lamp used.

text: If the rear position lamp or reversing lamp of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.
quote: The answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.
condition: A lamp function of the rear lamp is used to provide the optional answer-back signal on the vehicle
test_case: Activate the answer-back signal with the vehicle in park and outside park; pass if it operates only in the park condition.

text: If the rear position lamp or reversing lamp of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal and the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
quote: If the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
condition: A lamp function of the rear lamp is used to provide a flashing answer-back signal
test_case: Measure the flash frequency of the answer-back signal; pass if it is not more than 2.0 Hz.

text: If a lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices where the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line.
quote: the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line.
condition: A lamp function of the rear lamp is used to provide the optional answer-back signal on the vehicle
test_case: Check the approval of the lamp and measure the intensity in answer-back mode; pass if approved and not more than 700 cd on or above the HH line.

text: The stop lamps of the rear lamp shall not be used to provide the answer-back signal.
quote: However, front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps are not permitted to be used.
condition: The vehicle has an answer-back signal
test_case: Activate the answer-back signal and observe the rear lamp; pass if the stop lamp is not lit.

text: If a lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user in proximity to the vehicle.
quote: The answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection
condition: A lamp function of the rear lamp is used to provide the optional answer-back signal on the vehicle
test_case: Check the activation triggers of the answer-back signal; pass if they are limited to locking/unlocking or user-proximity detection.

text: If a lamp function of the rear lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds, defined from the beginning to the end of the signal, irrespective of whether it contains flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.
quote: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds.
condition: A lamp function of the rear lamp is used to provide the optional answer-back signal on the vehicle
test_case: Time the answer-back signal from the start to the end of the signal; pass if it is not more than 3 s.

text: If reversing projections are provided on the vehicle, the reversing projections shall be switched ON only when the reversing lamp(s) is/are switched ON.
quote: If provided, the reversing projections shall be switched ON only when the reversing lamp(s) is/are switched ON.
condition: The vehicle is fitted with reversing projectors
test_case: Attempt to activate the reversing projection with the reversing lamp OFF and ON; pass if it operates only when the reversing lamp is ON.

text: In the case of reciprocal incorporation where the non-textured outer lens is excluded and "7b" is the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2., F1 shall not be transparent to F2.
quote: "7b" is the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2. and F1 shall not be transparent to F2
condition: Rear position and stop lamps are reciprocally incorporated with a non-textured outer lens excluded from the apparent surface
test_case: Inspect the lamp construction and verify the optical part of function F1 does not transmit the light of function F2.

text: For the verification of the visibility of a red lamp to the front (paragraph 5.10.4.), the zone 1 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
quote: In height, by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground
test_case: Check on the vehicle that no red light from the rear position or stop lamp is directly visible from the front within the zone between 1 m and 2.2 m above ground.

text: For the verification of the visibility of a red lamp to the front (paragraph 5.10.4.), the zone 1 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in width by a vertical plane which, forming to the front an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, passes through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width.
quote: In width, by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane
test_case: Observe from the front zone bounded by the 15° outward planes through the vehicle width contact points and verify no red light from the rear lamp is directly visible.

text: For the verification of the visibility of a white lamp to the rear (paragraph 5.10.4.), the zone 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground and in width by a vertical plane forming to the rear an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, passing through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width.
quote: the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer are bounded: - In height, by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m
test_case: Observe from the rear zone (1 m to 2.2 m height, 15° outward planes) and verify white light visibility complies with paragraph 5.10 (reversing lamp excepted).

text: If there are several points of contact of the vertical planes delimiting the vehicle's overall width, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
quote: if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane
test_case: Verify the observation zone construction uses the foremost contact point for the forward plane and rearmost for the rearward plane.

text: The values measured for the distances of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
quote: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
test_case: Compare the measured distances with the individual specifications for each function; pass if all limits are met.

text: The position of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6., in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
quote: The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked
test_case: Measure the lamp positions in width, height and length on the vehicle per paragraphs 2.10.2.–2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4.; pass if the measurements follow those general requirements.

text: The values measured for the angles of geometric visibility shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3° variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
quote: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits
test_case: Compare the measured visibility angles with each function's specified angles, allowing ±3°; pass if they are within limits.

text: The angles of geometric visibility of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
quote: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
test_case: Determine the geometric visibility angles on the vehicle per paragraph 2.10.7.; pass if the check is carried out per that method.

text: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
quote: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10.
test_case: Check per paragraph 5.10. that red light from the rear lamp is not visible from the front and that white light (other than from the reversing lamp) is not visible from the rear; pass if paragraph 5.10. is met.

text: The rear position, stop and reversing lamps and their tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
quote: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation
test_case: Operate the lamps and any tell-tales and verify their switching against paragraphs 5.11.–5.14. and the individual specifications; pass if they comply.

text: The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
quote: The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
test_case: Switch on the rear position, stop and reversing lamps from the vehicle electrical system; pass if each lamp operates.

text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the lamps shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
quote: These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
test_case: Compare the inspected lamp colours (red rear position, stop and retro-reflector; white reversing), number and category with paragraphs 5.15., 5.16. and the individual specifications; pass if all are met.

text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
quote: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
test_case: Visually inspect the lamps and their approval markings for presence, number, colour, arrangement and category; pass if the inspection is completed.

text: A separate approval is required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1 (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp).
quote: A separate approval is required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1.
test_case: Check that each function (R1/R2, S1/S2, AR) is covered by its own approval.
