text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector) satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
quote: approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation
test_case: Check that each function in the combination lamp holds or meets the requirements of its applicable Regulation (R148, R150).

text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of the unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
quote: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
test_case: Review the function list of the unit and confirm that no non-compliant or unapproved function is integrated.

text: All the devices of an interdependent lamp system must be submitted for type approval by the same applicant.
quote: All the devices of an interdependent lamp system must be submitted for type approval by the same applicant.
condition: The lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Check that the approval documents of all interdependent lamps name the same applicant.

text: The rear position lamp shall be identified by the symbol R1 (steady) or R2 (variable).
quote: Rear position lamp (steady) R1 5.2. ... Rear position lamp (variable) R2 5.2.
test_case: Check that the marking shows R1 or R2, matching the intensity control of the rear position lamp.
merged: The stop lamp shall be identified by the symbol S1 (steady) or S2 (variable).

text: The reversing lamp shall be identified by the symbol AR (the letters A and R may be mingled).
quote: Reversing lamp (note: the letters A and R may be mingled) AR 5.8.
test_case: Check that the marking shows the symbol AR.

text: The applicable change index for the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp shall be 0 for the 00 series and 1 for the 01 series of amendments.
quote: The applicable change indexes for each device relating to the series of amendments shall be as follows
test_case: Compare the marked change index with Table 2 for each function.

text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings
test_case: Inspect the drawing and sample to confirm that a marking space large enough for all required markings exists.

text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible,
test_case: Inspect the markings visually and apply a rub test; the markings shall remain legible.

text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
test_case: Measure the dimension "a" of the approval marking; it shall be ≥ 5 mm.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
test_case: Inspect the marking for a circled E followed by the country number.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
quote: The four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
test_case: Inspect the marking for a 4 to 6 digit sequential number matching the approval number.

text: The sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
test_case: Check that the sequential number is located adjacent to the circled E mark.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
quote: The symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
test_case: Inspect the marking for the function symbols per Table 1.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force
test_case: Inspect the marking for "148R" followed by the series digits (e.g. 01).

text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
quote: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
condition: The lamp is left/right handed and cannot be mounted on either side indiscriminately
test_case: Inspect handed lamp samples for a horizontal arrow in the marking.

text: In the case of rear position lamps, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: ... (b) Front or rear position lamps
condition: The lamp cannot be mounted on either side indiscriminately
test_case: With the lamp in its mounting position, check that the arrow points outboard.

text: In the case of reversing lamps with reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: ... (c) Reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
condition: The reversing lamp has reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps
test_case: Check that the arrow points outboard on the reversing lamp marking.

text: If applicable, the additional letter "D" shall be placed to the right side of the function symbol on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
quote: The additional letter "D", on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps;
condition: The lamp is used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps
test_case: Inspect the marking for "D" to the right of the relevant symbol.
merged: If applicable, the additional letter "Y" shall be placed to the right side of the function symbol on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.

text: On lamps with reduced light distribution (see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3), the marking shall include a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
quote: On lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
condition: The lamp has reduced light distribution
test_case: Inspect the marking for a downward vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment.

text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
quote: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the approval marking.

text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the applicant's trade name or mark.

text: Lamps, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
quote: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating: (a) The category or categories of light source(s) prescribed;
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light sources
test_case: If the light sources are replaceable, inspect for the light source category marking.

text: Where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), it shall also bear a marking of the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
quote: in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s);
condition: The lamp is approved for LED substitute light sources
test_case: Inspect for the LED substitute light source category marking.

text: Lamps with non-replaceable light sources shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
quote: in the case of lamps with: ... (d) Non-replaceable light sources.
condition: The LED light sources are non-replaceable
test_case: Inspect for a rated voltage marking (e.g. 12V) or voltage range.

text: Lamps with an electronic light source control gear shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (a) An electronic light source control gear
condition: The lamp contains an electronic light source control gear
test_case: Inspect for a rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: Lamps with a variable luminous intensity control shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
quote: in the case of lamps with: ... (b) A variable luminous intensity control
condition: The lamp has a variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Inspect for a rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: Lamps with a secondary operating mode shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
quote: in the case of lamps with: ... (c) A secondary operating mode
condition: The lamp has a secondary operating mode
test_case: Inspect for a rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, bear the following markings. (a) On the light source module(s): (i) The trade name or mark of the applicant;
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used
test_case: Inspect the module for the applicant's trade name or mark.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module, comprising the starting letters "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle (with additional symbols or characters if several non-identical modules are used); the approval mark shall be from the same applicant as that on the lamp.
quote: This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used
test_case: Inspect the module for an MD code followed by the approval mark without the circle.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
quote: (iii) The rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used
test_case: Inspect the module for a rated voltage marking.
merged: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
quote: (b) On the lamp: (i) The specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii);
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the module identification code.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the approval mark in the specific identification code of the light source module does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant.
quote: The approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source module(s)
test_case: Compare the approval mark in the module identification code with the lamp approval mark and confirm that both belong to the same applicant.

text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
quote: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked
condition: The lamp has an external electronic control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Inspect the external control gear for an identification number and the manufacturer name.

text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
quote: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated
test_case: Verify that the marking is on a part not designed to be separated from the light-emitting lens.

text: The approval marking, as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
quote: shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
test_case: With the lamp fitted on the vehicle, check that the marking is visible, if necessary with the boot lid or a door opened.

text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both
condition: The outer lens is designed to be separable from the housing
test_case: If the lens is detachable, inspect both the lens and the housing for the approval marking.

text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
quote: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only
condition: The outer lens is shared by several devices with different approval markings
test_case: Inspect each device body; it shall carry only its own function markings.

text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
quote: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
test_case: Inspect the lamp to confirm that all the listed markings are affixed on it.

text: The markings in paragraph 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the light source module component.
quote: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used
test_case: Inspect the module itself for the 3.3.3.5(a) markings.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the approval marking shall be visible after their installation.
quote: This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that: It is visible after their installation;
condition: A single approval mark is used for the combined rear position, stop and reversing lamps (and retro-reflector).
test_case: Inspect the lamp installed on a representative vehicle mounting and confirm the single approval mark is visible.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
condition: A single approval mark is used for the combined rear position, stop and reversing lamps (and retro-reflector).
test_case: Review the design/drawing and check that every light-transmitting part (e.g. outer lens) carries or is inseparable from the approval mark.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks
condition: A single approval mark is used for the combined lamp.
test_case: Measure the approval mark components and compare with the minimum sizes required by the pertinent Regulations (e.g. R148, R150).

text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
quote: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
test_case: Verify by test report that the rear position, stop and reversing lamps meet all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5.

text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulation No. 48 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply, the requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the M1 vehicle category being applied where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
test_case: Check the lamp against the R48 sections 5 and 6 provisions for rear position, stop and reversing lamps on M1 vehicles that are verifiable at lamp approval (e.g. geometric visibility, apparent surface).

text: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use
test_case: Perform vibration/durability testing and confirm photometric and colorimetric characteristics are retained afterwards.

text: Where the rear position lamp or stop lamp is an assembly of two independent lamps to be type approved as lamp marked "D", it shall be type approved accordingly.
quote: An assembly of two independent lamps to be type approved as lamp marked "D" is applicable to front and rear position lamps, stop lamps
condition: The rear position or stop lamp is approved as an assembly of two independent lamps ("D").
test_case: Check the design and marking for a "D" assembly and confirm it applies only to position or stop lamp functions.
merged: Where the rear position lamp or stop lamp is an interdependent lamp system to be type approved as lamps marked "Y", it shall be type approved accordingly.

text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source), or be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
quote: in the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources
condition: The rear position lamp and the stop lamp are reciprocally incorporated.
test_case: Review the circuit design to confirm multiple light sources provide the functions, or that the lamp is declared for vehicles with a failure tell-tale.

text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, a note shall be made within the communication document on whether the functions are provided by multiple light sources or intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure.
quote: In either case, a note shall be made within the communication document.
condition: The rear position lamp and the stop lamp are reciprocally incorporated.
test_case: Check the communication document contains the relevant note.

text: The stop lamps and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
quote: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
test_case: Inspect the stop and reversing lamp apparent surfaces and confirm no logo is incorporated in their optics or lens texture.

text: If the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside the apparent surface of the rear position lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, only one logo shall be incorporated and all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation shall be fulfilled.
quote: may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled
condition: The rear position lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo.
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the number of logos and verify photometry and colour of the function with the logo meet the requirements.

text: If the rear position lamp incorporates a logo, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed, as confirmed by the applicant by a statement.
quote: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed.
condition: The rear position lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo.
test_case: Check the logo is the vehicle or body manufacturer's brand logo and that the applicant's statement exists.

text: If the rear position lamp incorporates a logo, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
quote: the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2
condition: The rear position lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo.
test_case: Measure the projected enclosed logo surface in the reference axis direction and confirm it is ≤ 100 cm2.

text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
quote: a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source
test_case: Review the LED wiring diagram of each function to identify the light-source groups considered as one light source for failure assessment.

text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single rear position lamp or stop lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.7.8. and 6.11.8. etc. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced, in which case a note in the communication form states that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply
test_case: Simulate failure of each light source (group) and measure intensities against Annex 3 minima with maxima met when all are lit, or verify a failure tell-tale signal is produced.

text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single reversing lamp containing more than one light source, the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded, or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure shall be produced.
quote: The light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3
condition: The reversing lamp contains more than one light source.
test_case: Simulate single light-source failure in the reversing lamp and check intensities remain above Annex 3 minima, or a failure signal is produced.

text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
quote: A rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1;
condition: The rear position lamp is category R2 with variable intensity control.
test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and verify the lamp automatically reverts to steady intensity within R1 limits.
merged: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.

text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128
test_case: Review the BOM and design to confirm the LEDs are non-replaceable light sources, light source modules or R37/R99/R128 approved replaceable light sources.

text: In case a light source category or categories or type(s) is restricted for use in lamps on vehicles in use and originally equipped with such lamps, the applicant for type approval of the lamp shall declare that the lamp is only intended for installation on those vehicles, and this shall be noted in the communication form.
quote: the applicant for type approval of the lamp shall declare that the lamp is only intended for installation on those vehicles
condition: Lamp uses a replaceable light source category restricted for use in lamps on vehicles in use
test_case: Check the light source categories used; if any is restricted, verify that the applicant's declaration and the note in the communication form are present.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
quote: The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one;
condition: The lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources.
test_case: Attempt to insert the light source in incorrect orientations and confirm only the correct position is possible.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, applying the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed and, where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to that category.
quote: The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.
condition: The lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources.
test_case: Gauge the holder against the relevant IEC 60061 data sheet(s).

text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
test_case: Perform EMC emission testing (e.g. per UN R10) and confirm no disturbances causing malfunction of other vehicle systems.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
quote: it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s)
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules.
test_case: Attempt incorrect fitting and tool-less removal of the module; both shall be impossible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules.
test_case: Inspect module construction to confirm it cannot be opened or altered without destruction.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
quote: regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source; and/or
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules.
test_case: Attempt to interchange the module with approved light sources and with other modules in the same housing; fitting shall be impossible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
quote: when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules.
test_case: Replace the module with another of the same identification code and repeat photometric measurements; results shall comply.

text: All photometric and colorimetric measurements shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraph 4.8., with the particulars of the methods of measurement given in Annex 3.
quote: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the following conditions.
test_case: Review test report to confirm photometric and colorimetric measurements followed paragraph 4.8 conditions and Annex 3 methods.

text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
quote: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
condition: The lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources.
test_case: Confirm the test report records use of R.E.5 standard light sources.

text: For replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.
quote: the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources controlled by electronic control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Measure the standard light source flux at test voltage and confirm it is within ±5 % of the reference/objective flux.

text: For a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
quote: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present
condition: Lamp uses LED light source modules or non-replaceable LED light sources
test_case: Review the test report and confirm that the photometric measurements were made with the LED sources fitted in the lamp.

text: For a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately in accordance with each applicable condition set forth in paragraph 4.8.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
condition: A function uses light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.8
test_case: Confirm that the test report shows a separate measurement for each light source condition.

text: For a lamp (function) using light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.8., all separate measurement results shall be added together.
quote: All separate measurement results shall be added together.
condition: A function uses light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.8
test_case: Check that the reported intensities equal the sum of the separate measurements.

text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
quote: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
test_case: Inspect the photometric set-up and confirm that masking is in place to prevent stray reflections.

text: Where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one position or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer
condition: Lamp may be installed in more than one position or in a field of positions
test_case: Confirm that photometry was repeated at each declared mounting position or at the extreme positions.

text: Where the lamp is also to be approved with LED substitute light source(s), all photometric and colorimetric measurements shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed.
quote: all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed
condition: Applicant requests approval with LED substitute light sources
test_case: Confirm that the photometric and colour results exist for the LED substitute sources.

text: For a lamp intended to be mounted inside the vehicle, a sample plate or sample plates as supplied shall be positioned in front of the lamp to be tested, in the geometrical position(s) as described in the application drawing(s).
quote: a sample plate or sample plates (in case of different possibilities) as supplied (see paragraph 3.1.2.8.) shall be positioned in front of the lamp
condition: Lamp is intended to be mounted inside the vehicle
test_case: Verify that the test was done with the sample plate in the drawing-defined position.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
quote: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
test_case: Verify that the rear position, stop and reversing lamps were measured with steady (continuous) operation.

text: In case the results of measurements are challenged, the distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable.
quote: The distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable
test_case: Check that the goniophotometer distance satisfies far-field inverse-square conditions.

text: In case the results of measurements are challenged, the measuring equipment shall be such that the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree.
quote: the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree
test_case: Verify from the receiver geometry that the angular aperture is between 10' and 1°.

text: In case the results of measurements are challenged, the intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation.
quote: shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree
test_case: For a disputed point, confirm the requirement is met within 0.25° of the nominal direction.

text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of each light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
quote: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
test_case: Confirm that the apparent surface limits along the reference axis are documented for the position, stop and reversing lamps.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
quote: the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems)
test_case: Measure the supply voltage at the lamp terminals during testing and confirm 13.5 V (12 V system) or 28 V (24 V system).

text: For a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
quote: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant
condition: Lamp is controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Confirm that the test operating conditions match the applicant's declared control gear settings.

text: For a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control and with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
quote: in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant
condition: Lamp has LED modules or non-replaceable sources without electronic control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Confirm that the lamp was operated under the applicant-declared conditions during the test.

text: For a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control with replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
quote: the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources without electronic control gear
test_case: Check that the source was set to the reference flux, or that the intensities were corrected proportionally.

text: For lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the light sources shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources.
quote: shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent
condition: Lamp has multiple replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Measure each source's flux and confirm it is within ±5 % of the average.

text: For lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
quote: The measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
condition: Lamp has multiple replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Verify the proportional correction calculation in the test report.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: On the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
test_case: Measure the HV intensity of both samples for each function and confirm it is at least the paragraph 5 minimum.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: In no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum, specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
test_case: Scan the full visible field of both samples and confirm that no intensity exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5 by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or not less than the intensity value specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3.
quote: be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified
test_case: Measure every Annex 3 grid point and confirm it is at least the minimum × percentage, or the stated value.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table
test_case: Measure across the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles and confirm the minimum intensity is met.

text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
quote: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
test_case: Evaluate the distribution against the Annex 3 local-variation rules.

text: If the applicant requests the additional test to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No. 48, the maximum intensity of the lamp in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction shall not be more than 2.5∙10-1 cd.
quote: to show that in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction, the maximum intensity is not more than 2.5∙10-1cd
condition: Applicant requests the additional test for red light towards the front / white light towards the rear
test_case: Goniophotometer scan of the field 165°-180° outboard H and -2.5° to +5° V (optionally with vehicle body influence); pass if no measured intensity exceeds 0.25 cd.

text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, it shall comply with the requirements for maximum intensity if all lamps together are lit.
quote: it shall comply with the requirements for: (a) Maximum intensity if all lamps together are lit
condition: Function is provided by two independent lamps marked "D"
test_case: Light both lamps together and confirm that the maximum is not exceeded.

text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, it shall comply with the requirements for minimum intensity if either lamp has failed.
quote: (b) Minimum intensity if either lamp has failed.
condition: Function is provided by two independent lamps marked "D"
test_case: Disable each lamp in turn and confirm that the minimum intensities are still met.

text: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
quote: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
condition: Lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify photometry against the requirements.

text: If the interdependent lamp system providing the rear position lamp is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement at all fixed positions of the movable component(s); the inboard geometric visibility requirement is deemed satisfied if these lamp(s) still conform to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
quote: the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement, at all fixed positions
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent system split between a fixed and a movable component (e.g. tailgate)
test_case: Test the designated lamp(s) at each fixed position of the movable component and confirm outboard visibility, colour and photometry.

text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
quote: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities: Outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
condition: Lamp uses variable intensity control (e.g. R2/S2)
test_case: Drive the variable intensity control across all its states and confirm the intensities stay within the paragraph 5 range.

text: For systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions, the variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5 for the specific lamp under night-time conditions.
quote: Exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp: (a) For systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions
condition: Lamp uses a day/night-only variable intensity control
test_case: Measure the intensity in night-time mode and confirm it does not exceed the steady maximum.

text: For other variable intensity systems, the variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5 for the specific lamp under standard conditions (good visibility, MOR > 2,000 m, and clean lens).
quote: (b) For other systems: under standard conditions
condition: Lamp uses another type of variable intensity control
test_case: Measure the intensity under simulated standard conditions and confirm it does not exceed the steady maximum.

text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities measured of the two lamps turned on simultaneously and the intensity of the rear position lamp turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by ±5° V and ±10° H of the light distribution table.
quote: the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp
condition: Rear position lamp and stop lamp are reciprocally incorporated
test_case: Measure the combined stop+position intensity against the position-only intensity at grid points within ±5° V / ±10° H and confirm a ratio of at least 5:1.

text: If one or both of the reciprocally incorporated rear position and stop lamps contain more than one light source and are considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered for the 5:1 ratio are those obtained with all sources in operation.
quote: the values to be considered are those obtained with all sources in operation
condition: Rear position and stop lamps are reciprocally incorporated with multiple light sources considered as a single lamp
test_case: Confirm that the ratio was evaluated with all sources lit.

text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
quote: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
test_case: Confirm that the photometric test procedure follows Annex 8.

text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function
test_case: Measure chromaticity within the Annex 3 grid field of the red and white functions.

text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
quote: Outside this field no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
test_case: Inspect the colour visually or by measurement outside the grid and confirm there is no abrupt colour change.

text: To check the colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
quote: To check these colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
test_case: Verify that the colorimetric test conditions (voltage, operation) match paragraph 4.8.

text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
quote: for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp
condition: Lamp uses non-replaceable light sources
test_case: Confirm that the colour measurement was done with the LEDs fitted in the lamp.

text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
quote: the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions
condition: A function uses more than one light source technology
test_case: Confirm that a separate colour measurement exists for each light source technology.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of rear position lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
test_case: Measure both rear position lamp samples and compare them with Table 4.
merged: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.

text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4 cd and the maximum luminous intensity shall be 17 cd when used as a single lamp, with the standard light distribution per Figure A3-I.
quote: R1, MR or RM1 (steady) 4∙100 1.7∙101 8.5∙100 Figure A3-I Table A2-1 5∙10-2
condition: Rear position lamp is category R1 (steady)
test_case: Measure HV ≥ 4 cd, max ≤ 17 cd, and the Figure A3-I grid values.

text: For rear position lamps of category R2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4 cd and the maximum luminous intensity shall be 42 cd when used as a single lamp (21 cd for a lamp marked "D"), with the standard light distribution per Figure A3-I.
quote: R2 or RM2 (variable) 4∙100 4.2∙101 2.1∙101 Figure A3-I Table A2-1 5∙10-2
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 (variable intensity)
test_case: Measure HV ≥ 4 cd and max ≤ 42 cd (≤ 21 cd if marked D) across the variable intensity range.

text: For rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps, a luminous intensity of 60 cd shall be permitted below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
quote: a luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane
condition: Rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp
test_case: Confirm that the intensity below 5° down is ≤ 60 cd and that the Table 4 maximum is met elsewhere.

text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady) used as a lamp marked "D", the maximum luminous intensity shall be 8.5 cd.
condition: Rear position lamp is category R1 and marked "D"
test_case: Confirm that the maximum intensity is ≤ 8.5 cd.

text: Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1, the rear position lamp shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 0.05 cd as specified in Table 4.
quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility: See Table 4
test_case: Measure across the Table A2-1 angles and confirm ≥ 0.05 cd.

text: The rear position lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.
test_case: Assess the rear position lamp against the paragraph 4.6 failure provisions.

text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be red.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates and confirm they lie within the red colour boundaries.
merged: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.

text: For a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.60∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 1.30∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-I, and within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 the minimum luminous intensity shall be 3∙10^-1 cd, as given in Table 7.
condition: Stop lamp is category S1 (steady intensity)
test_case: Measure intensity on reference axis, at Figure A3-I grid points and across Table A2-1 angles; values within 60-260 cd (130 cd if 'D') and ≥0.3 cd in geometric visibility field.

text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 7.30∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 3.65∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-I, and within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 the minimum luminous intensity shall be 3∙10^-1 cd (day) and 7∙10^-2 cd (night), as given in Table 7.
condition: Stop lamp is category S2 (variable intensity)
test_case: Measure in day and night modes; intensities within 60-730 cd (365 cd if 'D') and ≥0.3 cd day / 0.07 cd night within Table A2-1 angles.

text: The minimum luminous intensity of the stop lamp within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as specified in Table 7.
quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility See Table 7.
test_case: Measure intensity across the Table A2-1 angular field; values not below the Table 7 minimum for the category.

text: The stop lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.
test_case: Simulate light source failure per paragraph 4.6 and verify the specified behaviour.
merged: The reversing lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.

text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 8.0∙10^1 cd, as given in Table 10.
test_case: Measure intensity on the reference axis; value ≥80 cd.
merged: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the maximum luminous intensity below 5°D shall be 8.00∙10^3 cd, as given in Table 10.

text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the maximum luminous intensity in or above the H-plane shall be 3.00∙10^2 cd, as given in Table 10.
test_case: Scan intensity in and above the H-plane; no value exceeds 300 cd.

text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the maximum luminous intensity below the H-plane, down to 5°D, shall be 6.00∙10^2 cd, as given in Table 10.
test_case: Scan intensity between H-plane and 5°D; no value exceeds 600 cd.

text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-V, as given in Table 10.
test_case: Measure at Figure A3-V grid points; values meet the required percentages of the minimum.

text: In the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices and the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied.
quote: the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied
condition: Reversing lamp intended to be installed exclusively in a pair of devices
test_case: Measure intensity at 30° inwards; value ≥25 cd.

text: Where the type approval of the reversing lamp is granted with photometric intensity verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards (reversing lamp intended to be installed exclusively in a pair of devices), the device shall only be installed in a pair.
quote: a statement in paragraph 9.1.3. of the communication form (see Annex 1) will inform that the device shall only be installed in a pair
condition: Reversing lamp approved under the pair-only condition (photometry verified only up to 30° inwards)
test_case: Check the approval documentation and vehicle installation drawings to confirm that the reversing lamp is installed only as one of a pair.

text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be white.
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of reversing lamp light through the lens; chromaticity within the white boundaries.

text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 80° outboard, as given in Table A2-1 (angles shown are for lamps mounted on the right side of the vehicle).
test_case: Goniometric check of the rear position lamp confirms visibility of the apparent surface over at least 45° inboard and 80° outboard.
merged: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 45° outboard, as given in Table A2-1 (angles shown are for lamps mounted on the right side of the vehicle).

text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below the H-plane, as given in Table A2-1.
test_case: Goniometric check confirms rear position lamp visibility at least 15° above and 15° below the H-plane.
merged: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below the H-plane, as given in Table A2-1.

text: For a rear position lamp (R1, R2) mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 80° outboard may be used only below the H-plane.
quote: a Reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm.
condition: Rear position lamp H-plane mounting height below 750 mm
test_case: Check that below the H-plane the rear position lamp is visible at least 20° inboard and 80° outboard, and full 45°/80° above the H-plane.
merged: For a stop lamp (S1, S2) mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 45° outboard may be used only below the H-plane.

text: For a rear position lamp (R1, R2) to be installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above / 5° below.
quote: b For lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm.
condition: Rear position lamp H-plane mounting height below 750 mm
test_case: Goniometric check confirms rear position lamp visibility at least 15° above and 5° below the H-plane.
merged: For a stop lamp (S1, S2) to be installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above / 5° below.

For an optional rear position lamp (R1, R2) to be installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 5° above / 15° below.
For an optional stop lamp (S1, S2) to be installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 5° above / 15° below.

text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
quote: the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits
test_case: Compute the required minimum at each grid point as the percentage of the required minimum, rounded down to three significant digits, and verify measured intensities meet it.

text: Where the rear position lamps are intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
quote: intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground
condition: Rear position lamp declared for a mounting height ≤ 750 mm above ground
test_case: If the declared mounting height is ≤ 750 mm, verify rear position lamp photometry down to 5° below horizontal only and confirm compliance there.

text: Where the stop lamps of category S1, S2 or MS are intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
quote: the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards: (a) Front and rear direction indicators lamps; (b) Front and rear position lamps;
condition: Stop lamp of category S1/S2 declared for a mounting height ≤ 750 mm above ground
test_case: If the declared mounting height is ≤ 750 mm, verify S1/S2 stop lamp photometry down to 5° below horizontal only and confirm compliance there.

text: If not otherwise specified, the direction H = 0° and V = 0° corresponds to the reference axis, which passes through the centre of reference and on the vehicle is horizontal, parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle and oriented in the required direction of visibility.
quote: The direction H = 0° and V = 0° corresponds to the reference axis. (On the vehicle, it is horizontal, parallel to the median longitudinal plane
test_case: Check that photometric measurements of each function are referenced to the declared reference axis and centre of reference.

text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
quote: the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value
test_case: Scan intensities between grid points for the rear position and stop lamps and verify each is at least the lowest surrounding grid minimum.

text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
quote: no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity
test_case: Visually inspect the reversing lamp; if local variations appear, measure between measuring directions and verify no value is below 50 % of the lower of the two adjacent minima.

text: The rear position lamps shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8) given by the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
quote: The values shown give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8).
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of the rear position lamp at the Figure A3-I points; each value shall be at least the stated percentage of the required minimum.

text: The stop lamps of category S1, S2 or MS shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 7) given by the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
quote: Standard light distribution for front and rear position lamps, parking lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, stop lamps (S1, S2 and MS)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of the stop lamp at the Figure A3-I points; each value shall be at least the stated percentage of the Table 7 minimum.
merged: The stop lamps of category S3 or S4 shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 7) given by the standard light distribution of Figure A3-III.

text: The reversing lamps shall meet, at the measuring points expressed in degrees of angle with the axis of reference, the minimum intensities in cd of the light emitted given in Figure A3-V.
quote: The values shown in figure A3-V give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities in cd.
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of the reversing lamp at the Figure A3-V points; each value shall be at least the stated cd value.

text: For reversing lamps, the directions H = 0° and V = 0° correspond to the axis of reference, which on the vehicle is horizontal, parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle and oriented in the required direction of visibility, and passes through the centre of reference.
quote: The directions H = O° and V = O° correspond to the axis of reference. On the vehicle they are horizontal, parallel to the median longitudinal plane
test_case: Check reversing lamp measurements are referenced to the declared axis of reference and centre of reference.

text: From a mechanical and geometric standpoint, the conformity requirements for the lamp shall be considered satisfied if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations
test_case: Compare production lamps with the approved type dimensionally; pass if deviations are within inevitable manufacturing tolerances.

text: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested when testing photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.
quote: the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested, when testing photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8.
test_case: Measure photometry of a randomly chosen production lamp per paragraph 4.8; pass if requirements are met.

text: In the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source, if the results of the photometric test do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.
quote: If, in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements
condition: Lamp is equipped with a replaceable light source
test_case: On failed photometric result, repeat test with another standard light source and check compliance.
merged: In the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source, if the results of the photometric test do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of the light emitted by the production lamps shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
test_case: Measure chromaticity of red and white functions under paragraph 4.9 conditions; pass if within colour boundaries.

text: In the case of non-replaceable filament light source(s) or light source module(s) equipped with non-replaceable filament light source, at any conformity of production check the holder of the type approval shall demonstrate the use in normal production and show the identification of the non-replaceable filament light source(s) as indicated in the type approval documentation.
quote: the holder of the type approval shall demonstrate the use in normal production and show the identification of the non-replaceable filament light source(s)
condition: Lamp uses non-replaceable filament light source(s) or a light source module with non-replaceable filament light source (product is stated as LED).
test_case: At CoP check, verify the production light source identification matches the type approval documentation.

text: Tests of conformity of the lamp under this Regulation shall cover the photometric and colorimetric characteristics.
quote: Tests of conformity in this Regulation shall cover the photometric and colorimetric characteristics.
test_case: Review the CoP test plan and records; pass if both photometric and colorimetric characteristics of the rear position, stop and reversing functions are covered.

text: Conformity tests on the lamp shall generally be carried out in accordance with the methods set out in this Regulation.
quote: Tests shall generally be carried out in accordance with the methods set out in this Regulation.
test_case: Compare the CoP test procedures with the R148 test methods; pass if they match or are demonstrated equivalent.

text: The sampled lamp shall be subjected to photometric measurements for the minimum values at the points listed in Annex 3 and the required chromaticity coordinates.
quote: The sampled lamp shall be subjected to photometric measurements for the minimum values at the points listed in Annex 3.and the required chromaticity coordinates.
test_case: Measure sampled lamp at Annex 3 points and chromaticity; pass if minimum values and coordinates are met.

text: The conformity requirements of mass-produced lamps shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
quote: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation
test_case: Compare production lamps with the approved type mechanically and geometrically; pass if differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

text: With respect to photometric performance, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any mass-produced lamp chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
quote: No measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
test_case: Measure photometry of a randomly chosen production lamp per paragraph 4.8.; pass if no value deviates from the paragraph 6.1.3. values.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of mass-produced lamps shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
test_case: Measure chromaticity of production lamps (red and white functions) under paragraph 4.9. conditions; pass if within specified coordinates.

text: The deviation of any specimen of samples A and B (all four mass-produced lamps selected at random) shall not be more than 20 per cent for the conformity of mass-produced lamps not to be contested.
quote: The conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if the deviation of any specimen of samples A and B (all four lamps) is not more than 20 per cent.
test_case: Measure photometric values of four randomly selected production lamps and verify that no specimen deviates by more than 20 per cent.

text: The approval marking arrangement of the rear combination lamp shall be made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation; the arrangements in Annex 7 are examples only.
quote: any other arrangement made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation is acceptable
test_case: Inspect the approval marking on the lamp and confirm its arrangement complies with paragraph 3.3.

text: For the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector in the same assembly, the approval marking shall indicate each function (e.g. R/R2, S/S2, AR, class IA/IB retro-reflector) with the 148R and 150R references and series of amendments, as shown in marking examples 3-a/3-b.
quote: two possible solutions for the marking of a light signalling lamp where two or more lamps are part of the same assembly
test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm every function symbol and the 148R/150R references with the series of amendments are present.

text: If the lamp uses light source modules, each light source module shall bear an identification code (e.g. MD E3 17325) linking it to the approval of the lamp with which it has been approved.
quote: The light source module bearing the identification code shown above has been approved together with a lamp approved in Italy
condition: The lamp uses light source modules (LED module type not confirmed)
test_case: Inspect each light source module and confirm the MD identification code matches the lamp approval number.

text: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
condition: A lamp function uses incandescent light sources only
test_case: Measure the intensities after photometric stability; all values must be within the min/max limits.

text: For reversing lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
test_case: Measure the reversing lamp intensities after 1 min and 10 min of operation, or calculate them via the HV ratio; all values must be within the min/max limits.

text: For rear position lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply
