test_case: Measure the rear position lamp intensities after 1 min and after 30 min or at photometric stability; all values must be within the min/max limits.
merged: For stop lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the rear position lamp is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON, with HV as the reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
quote: the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
test_case: Check the rear position lamp intensity distribution at 4 s after switch ON (scaled by the HV ratio); it must meet the min/max limits.
merged: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the stop lamp is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, with HV as the reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.

Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the reversing lamp is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, with HV as the reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.

text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time
condition: All lamp functions use LED technology only
test_case: Confirm that each function uses LEDs only and that the paragraph 1.2 measurements comply; compliance at all points in time is then deemed.
merged: In case a lamp (function) uses incandescent technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.1. are compliant.

text: In case a lamp (function) uses any other light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
quote: the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1
condition: A lamp function uses a light generating technology other than incandescent or LED
test_case: Measure the intensities from the Table A8-1 time until photometric stability; all values must comply.

text: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) are tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
quote: are tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
condition: A lamp function uses more than one light generating technology
test_case: Apply the strictest time requirements of paragraphs 2.1.1 to 2.1.3; the intensities must comply at those times.

text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of the lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
quote: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at all points in time
test_case: If run-up behaviour is doubtful, record the intensity continuously from the Table A8-1 time until stability; the minima must be met throughout.

text: A separate approval is required for the retro-reflector (Class IA or IB) as a retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1.
quote: A separate approval is required for each retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1.
test_case: Check that a separate UN R150 approval exists for the retro-reflector of the rear lamp.

text: The approval number assigned to the approved type of retro-reflector shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
quote: An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved and shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector sample for the approval number marked per paragraph 3.3.

text: If the approval granted for the retro-reflector is extended to other such devices differing only in colour, the two samples in any other colour submitted in conformity with paragraph 3.1.1.1. (d) shall be required to meet only the colorimetric and photometric specifications.
quote: the two samples in any other colour submitted in conformity with paragraph 3.1.1.1. (d) or 3.1.1.4. of this Regulation shall be required to meet only the colorimetric and photometric specifications
condition: Approval extended to retro-reflector variants differing only in colour
test_case: For a colour-only extension, test the two samples in the other colour for colorimetric and photometric compliance; pass if both meet the specifications.

text: The symbol identifying the retro-reflector shall be "IA" for a retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) or "IB" for a retro-reflector for motor vehicles combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight, with a minimum "a" of 5 mm, as given in Table 1.
quote: Retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) IA 5 5.1. Retro-reflector for motor vehicles (combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight) IB 5 5.1.
condition: Retro-reflector class (IA or IB) not stated
test_case: Verify the class symbol on the marking matches the class of the retro-reflector (IA or IB) and the lamp watertightness.

text: The applicable change index for the retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent, Class IA) or combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight (Class IB) shall be 0 for the 00 series and 1 for the 01 series of amendments, as given in Table 2.
quote: The applicable change indexes for each device relating to the series of amendments shall be as follows (see also paragraph 6.1.1.)
test_case: Check the approval documentation and marking of the retro-reflector; pass if the change index matches Table 2 for the series of amendments under which approval is granted.

text: Every retro-reflector belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2., or for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement
test_case: Inspect the drawings and sample for a marking space large enough for the approval marking/UI and other markings.

text: All markings on the retro-reflector shall be clearly legible and indelible.
quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
test_case: Visually inspect markings for legibility and perform a rub test to confirm indelibility.

text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be as defined in Table 1 (minimum 5 mm for Class IA and IB retro-reflectors).
quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” is defined in Table 1.
test_case: Measure the approval mark dimension "a" and confirm it is at least 5 mm.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
test_case: Inspect the marking for a circle surrounding "E" and the country distinguishing number.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., placed close to the approval mark.
quote: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2. This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
test_case: Inspect the marking for a 4-6 digit sequential number located close to the approval mark.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
quote: The symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
test_case: Inspect the marking for the class symbol IA or IB per Table 1.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force
test_case: Inspect the marking for "150R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments.

text: If the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
quote: The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below: Figure I Unique Identifier (UI)
condition: Whether the Unique Identifier is used instead of the approval marking
test_case: If UI is used, compare the marking format against Figure I.

text: The retro-reflector shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
test_case: Inspect the sample for the applicant's trade name or mark.

text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, the retro-reflector shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
quote: the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity
condition: Whether a TOP indication is necessary to determine the angle(s) of rotation
test_case: Check whether the retro-reflector is rotation-sensitive and, if so, that "TOP" is inscribed horizontally at the highest part of the illuminating surface.

text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraph 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflector.
quote: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector to confirm all markings are clearly legible.

text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, this marking shall be visible after their installation.
quote: This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that: It is visible after their installation.
condition: Whether a single approval mark is used for the rear combination lamp and retro-reflector
test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, verify the single approval mark is visible.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark
condition: Whether a single approval mark is used for the rear combination lamp and retro-reflector
test_case: Inspect construction to confirm that no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the single approval mark.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks
condition: Whether a single approval mark is used for the rear combination lamp and retro-reflector
test_case: Measure the components of the single approval mark and compare against the smallest minimum size of the pertinent regulations.

text: Every modification of the type of retro-reflector shall be notified to the Type Approval Authority which approved the type.
quote: Every modification of the type of retro-reflective device shall be notified to the Type Approval Authority which approved the type.
test_case: Review change records to confirm modifications were notified to the approving authority.

text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in those sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval, shall apply to the retro-reflector; the requirements pertinent to the retro-reflector and to the vehicle category (M1) on which it is intended to be installed shall be applied where their verification at the moment of type approval is feasible.
quote: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied
test_case: Review the retro-reflector against the applicable R48 sections 5 and 6 provisions verifiable at type approval; all feasible checks must pass.

text: The retro-reflector shall be so constructed that it functions satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
test_case: Inspect design and the results of the Annex 6/7 durability tests; the retro-reflector must keep functioning as specified.

text: The retro-reflector shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to its efficient operation or to its maintenance in good condition.
quote: they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition
test_case: Visually inspect samples; no design or manufacturing defects affecting operation or maintenance may be found.

text: The components of the retro-reflector or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector by hand without tools; the components must not separate easily.

text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be easy to clean.
quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
test_case: Inspect the outer surface; it must permit easy cleaning.

text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not be rough and any protuberances the outer surface may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
test_case: Visually and tactilely inspect the outer surface; no roughness and no protuberances hindering cleaning.

text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector when in normal use.
quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
test_case: Inspect the assembled lamp; the inner surface of the retro-reflector must not be accessible in normal use.

text: If the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
quote: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated
condition: Retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter (e.g. clear prism optics behind red outer lens)
test_case: Inspect the construction; optical unit and filter must not be separable under normal conditions of use.

text: The colouring of the retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
quote: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
test_case: Check material/BOM and inspect samples; colour must be achieved without paint or varnish (e.g. tinted PMMA).

text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device
test_case: Measure chromaticity x,y of the reflected light; values must lie within the R48 red night-time colour boundaries.

text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflector, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
quote: the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0°
test_case: Perform colorimetric measurement under Illuminant A at 1/3° divergence and β1=β2=0° (or Annex 4 angle) and record the conditions.

text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5
test_case: Measure the retro-reflector shape and dimensions; they must comply with Annex 5 (e.g. non-triangular shape).

text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
quote: (b) The photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
test_case: Perform photometric and colorimetric measurements; results must meet paragraphs 5.1.4 and 5.1.5.

text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
quote: (c) The physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction
test_case: Run the physical and mechanical tests of paragraph 5.1.7; all must be passed.

text: Ten samples of the retro-reflector shall be submitted for approval and shall be tested in the chronological order as indicated in paragraph 5.1.7.
quote: The applicant shall submit ten samples for approval which shall be tested in the chronological order as indicated in paragraph 5.1.7.
test_case: Check the test report confirms that ten retro-reflector samples were received and tested in the prescribed chronological order; pass if the sequence matches paragraph 5.1.7.

text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples of the retro-reflector shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
quote: the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined
test_case: Perform the Annex 6 Part 1 heat test on ten samples, then after ≥1 h measure colour and RI at 20', 0°/0°; values must comply.

text: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values after the heat resistance test shall be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
quote: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
test_case: Fully measure RI at all Table 3 angles on the min and max samples; all values must meet paragraph 5.1.4.

text: The first group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
quote: First group: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then
test_case: Perform the water penetration test followed by the fuel and lubricant resistance tests; samples must pass.

text: The second group of two retro-reflector samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
quote: Second group: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6
test_case: Perform the corrosion test (if applicable) and the rear-face abrasion test; samples must pass.

text: The third group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
quote: Third group: The two samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties
test_case: Perform the Annex 4 Part 3 stability test; samples must retain compliant optical properties.

text: The fourth group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
quote: Fourth group: The two samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
test_case: Perform the Annex 6 Part 6 weathering test; samples must pass.

text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
quote: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have: A colour which satisfies
test_case: Measure colour after each test group; chromaticity must satisfy paragraph 5.1.5.

text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
quote: A RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4. The verification shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20'
test_case: Measure RI at 20', β1=β2=0° after each test group; values must meet paragraph 5.1.4.

text: One or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI, shall be specified for the retro-reflector.
quote: the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0°
test_case: Check that the axis of reference is defined in the documentation and used for photometric testing.

text: Where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements of the retro-reflector shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference
condition: More than one or a range of axes of reference is specified
test_case: Repeat RI measurements for each specified axis/extreme axis; all must comply with Table 3.

text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflector as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2.
quote: contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2
test_case: Check the illuminating surface used for measurement lies within a 200 mm diameter circle and does not exceed 100 cm2.

text: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area of the retro-reflector to be used for photometric measurements.
quote: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area to be used.
test_case: Verify the drawings indicate the perimeter of the area used for photometry.

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and IB shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
quote: the RI values for red retro-reflectors must be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux
test_case: Measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1 paragraph 3 at all Table 3 angles; all values ≥ Table 3 minima.

text: For a red retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, at an angle of divergence of 20', the RI shall be at least 300 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 200 mcd/lx at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 100 mcd/lx at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
test_case: Measure RI at 20' divergence at the three illumination angle sets; values must be ≥300, ≥200 and ≥100 mcd/lx respectively.
merged: For a red retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, at an angle of divergence of 1°30', the RI shall be at least 5 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 2.8 mcd/lx at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 2.5 mcd/lx at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.

text: RI values of the retro-reflector lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
quote: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference
test_case: Scan RI within the defined solid angle; no value may fall below the relevant Table 3 minima.

text: Where the retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
quote: is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards
condition: Retro-reflector H plane mounting height on the vehicle is less than 750 mm above ground
test_case: Confirm mounting height; if <750 mm, verify RI downward angles only to 5° and check compliance.

text: The testing of the colour of the retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
quote: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
test_case: Verify the colour test report uses the paragraph 4.2.1 method (Illuminant A, 1/3°, 0°/0°).

text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white
test_case: Measure chromaticity of reflected light; x,y must be within the R48 red night-time limits.

text: The retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the tests in the chronological order given in Table 4 (Chronological order of tests, Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB).
quote: Chronological order of tests Table 4 Chronological order of tests (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB)
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB (not stated in the specification)
test_case: Review the test report and confirm the samples were tested in the Table 4 sequence.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the heat test of Part 1 of Annex 6 (48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C), followed by a visual inspection for distortion.
quote: Part 1 of Annex 6 Heat: 48 h at 65° ± 2°C Visual inspection for distortion
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Expose the samples for 48 h at 65 ± 2 °C, then inspect them; no distortion shall be visible.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall pass a visual inspection of the general specifications and a visual inspection of shapes and dimensions according to Annex 5.
quote: General specifications: visual inspection x x x x x x x x x x Annex 5 Shapes and dimensions: visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Inspect all samples visually against paragraph 4 and Annex 5; there shall be no non-conformity.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the colorimetry shall be checked by visual inspection, with trichromatic coordinates measured in case of doubt, and the photometry shall be checked at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°, with complete photometry on the designated samples according to Part 1 of Annex 4.
quote: Colorimetry: visual inspection Trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt x x x x x x x x x x x Part 1 of Annex 4 Photometry: limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Measure colour and RI at the stated geometry after the heat test, and complete photometry on two samples; the paragraph 4.2 limits shall be met.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the water test of Part 3 of Annex 6 (10 min in normal position and 10 min in inverted position) with visual inspection, followed by colorimetry and photometry checks limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 3 of Annex 6 Water: 10 min. in normal position 10 min. in inverted position visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Perform the water test and inspect the samples; then re-check colour and RI at 20', β = 0°.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the motor fuels test of Part 1 of Annex 7 (5 min) with visual inspection.
quote: Part 1 of Annex 7 Motor fuels: 5 min. visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Apply motor fuel for 5 min and inspect the samples; no visible deterioration shall be found.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the oils test of Part 2 of Annex 7 (5 min) with visual inspection, followed by colorimetry and photometry checks limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 2 of Annex 7 Oils: 5 min. visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Apply oil for 5 min, inspect the samples, then re-check colour and RI at the reduced geometry.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the corrosion test of Part 4 of Annex 6 (24 hours, a 2 hours interval, 24 hours) with visual inspection.
quote: Part 4 of Annex 6 Corrosion: 24 hours 2 hours interval 24 hours visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: Perform the salt-spray cycle 24 h / 2 h / 24 h and inspect the samples; no detrimental corrosion shall be found.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the rear face test of Part 4 of Annex 6 (1 min) with visual inspection, followed by colorimetry and photometry checks limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 4 of Annex 6 Rear face: 1 min. visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB with an accessible rear face
test_case: Apply the rear face test for 1 min, inspect the samples, then re-check colour and RI.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the stability in time test of Part 3 of Annex 4, followed by colorimetry (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 3 of Annex 4 Stability in time Par. 4.2. Colorimetry: Visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: After the stability-in-time exposure, measure colour and RI; the paragraph 4.2 limits shall be met.

text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test of Part 6 of Annex 6, followed by colorimetry (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 6 of Annex 6 Resistance to weathering Par. 4.2. Colorimetry: Visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates
condition: Retro-reflector class is IA or IB
test_case: After the weathering exposure, measure colour and RI; the limits shall be met.

text: From a mechanical and geometric standpoint, the differences of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations
test_case: Compare production retro-reflector samples dimensionally with the approved type; pass if deviations stay within inevitable manufacturing tolerances and the Regulation's requirements.

text: When testing photometric performances of any mass-produced retro-reflective device chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
quote: no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation
test_case: Measure the CIL values of a randomly chosen production retro-reflector; pass if no value is more than 20 per cent below the prescribed minimum.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall be complied with.
quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of a production retro-reflector sample; pass if they lie within the prescribed red boundaries.

text: The mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall be considered as satisfying the conformity requirements from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
quote: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation
test_case: Compare randomly sampled production retro-reflectors with the approved drawings and dimensions; pass if differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

text: With respect to photometric performance, when testing any mass-produced retro-reflective device chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
quote: No measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
test_case: Measure the photometric values (CIL) of randomly selected production retro-reflectors; pass if no value is more than 20 % below the prescribed minimum.

text: For mass-produced retro-reflective devices, the chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.
quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of production samples; pass if they fall within the prescribed red colour boundaries.

text: In the first sampling of four retro-reflective devices selected at random (samples A and B), the deviation of any specimen of samples A and B shall not be more than 20 per cent for the conformity of mass-produced retro-reflective devices not to be contested.
quote: shall not be contested if the deviation of any specimen of samples A and B (all four retro-reflective devices) is not more than 20 per cent
test_case: Measure photometric values of four randomly selected production retro-reflectors; pass if no specimen deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values.

text: One of the retro-reflectors of sample A, after the sampling procedure in paragraph 2., shall be tested for resistance to water penetration according to the procedure described in paragraph 1. of Part 2 of Annex 6. If it fails, both retro-reflective devices of sample B shall pass the same test.
quote: One of the retro-reflectors of sample A after the sampling procedure in paragraph 2. shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 1. of Part 2 of Annex 6
test_case: Perform the Annex 6 Part 2 paragraph 1 water penetration test on a production sample; pass if the test is passed, or if both sample B devices pass.

text: When the RI of the retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.
quote: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced
test_case: During goniophotometric measurement at β1 = β2 = 0°, turn the retro-reflector slightly and check for a mirror effect.

text: If any mirror effect is produced, a reading of the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
quote: If there is any such effect, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
test_case: If a mirror effect is observed, measure RI at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0° and use that reading.

text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
quote: retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified
condition: The retro-reflector is not marked "TOP".
test_case: Rotate the unmarked retro-reflector about its reference axis at β = 0°, α = 20' and verify the minimum RI meets the paragraph 5 value.

text: For retro-reflective devices not marked "TOP", when the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε (minimum RI), and if the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference only within ±5° from that position.
quote: the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε. If the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated
condition: The retro-reflector is not marked "TOP".
test_case: Measure RI at all other illumination/divergence angles at the minimum-RI ε position (±5° allowed) and verify specified values are met.

text: For retro-reflective devices marked "TOP", the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during the ±5° rotation.
quote: The RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
condition: The retro-reflector is marked "TOP".
test_case: Record RI throughout the ±5° rotation and verify no value is below the prescribed minimum.

text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.
quote: retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.
condition: The retro-reflector is marked "TOP".
test_case: Rotate the TOP-marked retro-reflector ±5° about its axis at β = 0°, α = 20' while measuring RI.

text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
quote: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements
test_case: If RI at β = 0°, ε = 0° is ≥150 % of the specified value, perform all measurements at ε = 0° and verify compliance.

text: The CIE-angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring the retro-reflective device.
quote: The CIE-angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring retro-reflective device and marking materials.
test_case: Check the test report states measurements were made in the CIE angular system of Figure A4-I.

text: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
quote: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A
test_case: Verify the test source is CIE Standard Illuminant A and the procedure follows Annex 4 Part 1.

text: For the measurement of the retro-reflective device, the measuring geometry of Figure A4-III shall respect the limits: angular diameter of the source δ ≤ 10', angular diameter of the measuring device γ ≤ 10', angular diameter of the illuminated area η ≤ 80'.
quote: Angular diameter of the source -δ≤10' Angular diameter of the measuring device -γ≤10' Angular diameter of the illuminated area -η≤80'
test_case: Check the test set-up geometry yields δ ≤ 10', γ ≤ 10' and η ≤ 80'.

text: The measuring distance shall be chosen in such an order that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η given in Figure A4-III are respected, but not lower than 10 m.
quote: The measuring distance shall be chosen in such an order that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η given above
test_case: Verify the test distance is ≥ 10 m and satisfies the δ, γ, η limits.

text: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device, measured perpendicular to the incident light, shall be sufficiently uniform, with a variation complying with max/min ≤ 1.05.
quote: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device, measured perpendicular to the incident light shall be sufficiently uniform.
test_case: Scan the illuminance over the useful area with a sensor ≤ 1/10 of the area and verify max/min ≤ 1.05.

text: The photometer head shall be corrected to the spectral luminous efficiency for the CIE standard photometric observer in photopic vision.
quote: The photometer head shall be corrected to the spectral luminous efficiency for the CIE standard photometric observer in photopic vision.
test_case: Check the photometer head calibration certificate shows V(λ) correction.

text: The photometer head shall not show a perceptible change in local sensitivity within the area of its aperture; otherwise suitable provisions shall be added, e.g. the application of a diffusing window at a certain distance in front of the sensitive surface.
quote: The device shall not show a perceptible change in local sensitivity within the area of its aperture; otherwise suitable provisions shall be added
test_case: Check the photometer head calibration record for uniform local sensitivity across the aperture, or confirm a diffusing window is fitted.

text: During photometry of the retro-reflective device, the field of view of the photometer head and the spread of light from both the sample and the source shall be restricted as much as possible.
quote: the field of view of the photometer head and the spread of light from both the sample and the source shall be restricted as much as possible
test_case: Review the test set-up for apertures and baffles that limit the photometer field of view and the source and sample light spread.

text: During photometry of the retro-reflective device, reflections from the floor and walls which occur over the relatively long test distances used shall be screened from both the sample and the photometer head by baffles.
quote: Reflections from the floor and walls which occur over the relatively long test distances used shall be screened from both the sample and the photometer head by baffles
test_case: Inspect the photometric range and confirm baffles screen floor and wall reflections from both the sample and the photometer head.

text: The residual stray light measured with the sample covered shall be subtracted from the value measured on the retro-reflective device.
quote: This value shall be subtracted from that measured on the retro-reflective device
test_case: Verify the test report shows stray light measured with the sample covered and subtracted from the RI readings.

text: For retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB, the shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
quote: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1.
condition: Retro-reflector is of Class IA or IB (class not stated in the specification)
test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector illuminating surface from 10 m and confirm its shape cannot easily be confused with the equilateral triangle of Class IIIA/IIIB.

text: Compliance of the retro-reflective device with the shape and dimension specifications shall be verified by visual inspection.
quote: Compliance with the above specifications shall be verified by visual inspection.
condition: Retro-reflector is of Class IA or IB (class not stated in the specification)
test_case: Perform and record a visual inspection of the retro-reflector shape and confirm it meets the Annex 5 shape specification.

text: For moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices of Classes IA and IB, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
quote: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C
test_case: Condition the retro-reflector 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C dry, then cool 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C, and record the conditioning log.

text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
quote: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector after heat conditioning; pass if no cracking or appreciable distortion, especially of the optical component.

text: For the water penetration test, the retro-reflective device, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
quote: shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C
test_case: Strip removable parts and immerse the device 10 min in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C with the top of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the water surface.

text: The water immersion test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
quote: This test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom
test_case: Repeat the 50 °C immersion with the device inverted, rear face under about 20 mm of water.

text: The retro-reflective device sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
quote: These sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
test_case: Immediately after the 50 °C immersions, immerse the device under the same conditions in water at 25 °C ± 5 °C.

text: After the water penetration test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit; if visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
quote: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
test_case: Visually inspect the reflecting surface after immersion; fail if water is clearly present.

text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water on the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit after the water penetration test, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
quote: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
test_case: After the immersion sequence, visually inspect the retro-reflector optical unit; any clearly visible water means fail.

text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
quote: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation
test_case: After lightly shaking off external water, measure the RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and check compliance with the required values.

text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust tests of Annex 6 Part 3 shall be applied to the Class IB retro-reflective device.
quote: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the following tests (moisture and dust test) shall be applied.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test report shows the moisture and dust tests of Annex 6 Part 3 were applied when the manufacturer chose this alternative.

text: The water spray cabinet shall be equipped with a nozzle(s) which provides a solid cone water spray of sufficient angle to completely cover the sample device, with the centreline of the nozzle(s) directed downward at an angle of 45° ± 5° to the vertical axis of the rotating test platform.
quote: The centreline of the nozzle(s) shall be directed downward at an angle of 45° ± 5° to the vertical axis of a rotating test platform.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check test set-up: spray cone fully covers the device and nozzle angle is 45° ± 5° to the platform axis.

text: The precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform.
quote: The precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Measure precipitation with the 100 mm high, min. 140 mm diameter collector on the platform axis; rate must be 2.5 to 4.1 mm/min.

text: In the water spray test, a sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded, shall be subjected to a water spray according to paragraphs 2.2.1 to 2.2.6 of Annex 6 Part 3.
quote: A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded shall be subjected to a water spray as follows:
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Verify the initial RI was recorded and the fixture-mounted sample was water-sprayed per Annex 6 Part 3 2.2.

text: During the water spray test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open, and drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
quote: All drain holes and other openings shall remain open. Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Inspect the test setup to confirm all openings are unobstructed and any drain wicks are fitted during the spray.
merged: During the dust exposure test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open, and drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.

text: During the water spray test, drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
quote: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
condition: Device uses drain wicks
test_case: Verify drain wicks are fitted in the sample during the water spray test.

text: During the water spray test, the device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.
quote: The device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min -1.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Measure the platform rotation speed and confirm it is within 3.5 to 4.5 min-1.

text: Since the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage during the water spray test according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
quote: these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test log shows the rear position, stop and reversing functions were cycled 5 min ON / 55 min OFF at design voltage.

text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
quote: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Verify from the test log that the spray lasted 12 hours, i.e. 12 cycles of 5/55 min.

text: After the water spray test, the rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
quote: The rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Confirm a 1 hour drain period with the door closed was observed after the spray.

text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed in the device, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
quote: No standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Inspect the interior, then tap and tilt the device; pass if no standing pool of water is present or forms.

text: Upon completion of the drain period, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
quote: The RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Dry the exterior with a dry cotton cloth and measure the RI per Annex 4 Part 1; compare it with the initial RI.

text: Upon completion of the drain period, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
quote: Upon completion of the drain period. The interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Visually inspect the device interior after draining and record any moisture accumulation.

text: The test dust used in the dust exposure test shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
quote: The test dust used shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test report confirms the dust is fine powdered cement to ASTM C 150-84.

text: In the dust exposure test, a sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust according to paragraphs 2.3.5 to 2.3.7 of Annex 6 Part 3.
quote: A sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as follows:
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Verify the initial RI was recorded and the fixture-mounted sample was dust-exposed per Annex 6 Part 3 2.3.

text: During the dust exposure test, drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
quote: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
condition: Device uses drain wicks
test_case: Verify drain wicks are fitted in the sample during the dust exposure test.

text: During the dust exposure test, the test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours, and the dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
quote: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Check the test log for 2 to 15 s agitation every 15 min over 5 hours, with settling between agitations.

text: The mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall, and devices with a length exceeding 600 mm shall be horizontally centred in the test chamber.
quote: The mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Measure the device-to-wall distance (at least 150 mm) and check centring if the length exceeds 600 mm.

text: During the dust exposure test, devices with a length exceeding 600 mm shall be horizontally centred in the test chamber.
quote: Devices with a length exceeding 600 mm shall be horizontally centred in the test chamber.
condition: Device length exceeds 600 mm
test_case: Measure device length; if >600 mm verify horizontal centring in the dust chamber.

text: During the dust exposure test, the dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
quote: The dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Review test log: no agitation between the 2 to 15 s agitation bursts at 15 min intervals.

text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
quote: the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative moisture and dust tests
test_case: Clean and dry the exterior, measure the RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and evaluate it against the initial RI.

text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
quote: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences
test_case: Perform the corrosion test of Annex 6 Part 4 and verify the photometric and colorimetric values still meet the prescribed limits.

text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflective device to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked, according to ISO Standard 9227:2017.
quote: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked
test_case: Inspect the front surface and rear-face protection after the ISO 9227:2017 salt spray test; there must be no tarnishing or deterioration.

text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
quote: shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours
test_case: Check the test record shows the combination lamp, stripped of removable parts, was exposed to 2 x 24 h saline mist with a 2 h drying interval.

text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
quote: the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution
condition: The retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion.
test_case: Verify the salt spray chamber was run at 35 °C ± 2 °C with a 5 % NaCl solution in distilled water with ≤0.02 % impurities.

text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
quote: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the salt spray test; no corrosion impairing efficiency is allowed.

text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
quote: at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9
test_case: After 48 h recovery, measure RA at β2 = 5°, α = 20' and compare against Table 9 minimum and Table 10 maximum.

text: Before measuring the coefficient of retro-reflection after the corrosion test, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
quote: Before measuring, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
test_case: Confirm in the test record that salt deposits were removed before the post-corrosion photometric measurement.

text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB with an accessible mirror-backed rear face, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
quote: The reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
condition: The retro-reflector is a moulded plastics Class IA/IB reflector with an accessible mirror-backed rear face.
test_case: Verify the test record shows the rear face was brushed with a hard nylon brush.

text: After having brushed the rear face, in the case of moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute, after which the cloth is removed and the retro-reflective device left to dry.
quote: a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute
condition: The retro-reflector is a moulded plastics Class IA/IB reflector with an accessible mirror-backed rear face.
test_case: Apply a cotton cloth soaked in the Annex 7 Part 1 mixture to the rear face for 1 min, remove and let dry.

text: For mirror-backed retro-reflective devices with accessible rear face, as soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
quote: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
condition: The retro-reflector is a moulded plastics Class IA/IB reflector with an accessible mirror-backed rear face.
test_case: Verify the rear face was brushed again with the same nylon brush after evaporation.

text: For mirror-backed retro-reflective devices with accessible rear face, the RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
quote: The RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face
condition: The retro-reflector is a moulded plastics Class IA/IB reflector with an accessible mirror-backed rear face.
test_case: Cover the rear face with Indian ink, measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and check compliance with the required values.

text: The accelerated artificial weathering apparatus shall be in accordance with EN ISO 4892-1:2016 and EN ISO 4892-2:2013, shall be capable to control temperature and relative humidity and shall be equipped with a water spray system.
quote: The apparatus shall be in accordance with EN ISO 4892-1:2016 and EN ISO 4892-2:2013 and shall be capable to control temperature
test_case: Confirm the test laboratory's weathering apparatus conforms to EN ISO 4892-1/-2 with humidity control and water spray.

text: The water spray system of the accelerated artificial weathering apparatus shall be capable to spray a minimum of 0.3 ml/cm² within 5 minutes.
quote: The water spray system shall be capable to spray a minimum of 0.3 ml/cm² within 5 minutes.
test_case: Check the apparatus calibration record shows spray capacity of at least 0.3 ml/cm² within 5 minutes.

text: The spray water used in the accelerated artificial weathering test shall be in accordance to the requirements of EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
quote: The spray water used shall be in accordance to the requirements of EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
test_case: Verify spray water quality records against EN ISO 4892-2:2013.

text: The test method used for the accelerated artificial weathering (TM1 Black-standard or TM2 Black-panel thermometer) shall be specified in the report.
quote: The test method used shall be specified in the report.
test_case: Review the weathering test report; pass if it states whether TM1 or TM2 was used.

text: When subjected to the resistance to weathering test, the retro-reflective device samples shall be exposed to accelerated artificial weathering in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1.
quote: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1:
test_case: Review the weathering test report to confirm exposure was carried out per EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with the Table A6-1 parameters.

text: In case of retro-reflective devices, the samples shall be exposed to accelerated artificial weathering in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 for a period of 500 hours.
quote: in case of retro-reflective devices for a period of 500 hours,
test_case: Verify from the test log that the retro-reflector samples were exposed for 500 hours.

text: When test method TM1 (Black-standard thermometer) is used, the accelerated artificial weathering shall use cycle No. 1 according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013: 102 min dry / 18 min water spray, broadband (300 to 400 nm) irradiance 60 ± 2 W/m², narrowband (340 nm) irradiance 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m², black-standard temperature 65 ± 3 °C and relative humidity 50 ± 10 %.
quote: TM1 - Black-standard thermometer Cycle No. according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013 Exposure period Irradiance Black-standard temperature °C Relative humidity %
condition: Test method TM1 (Black-standard thermometer) is chosen
test_case: Check the weathering chamber records against the TM1 parameters of Table A6-1.
merged: When test method TM2 (Black-panel thermometer) is used, the accelerated artificial weathering shall use cycle No. 4 according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013: 102 min dry / 18 min water spray, broadband (300 to 400 nm) irradiance 60 ± 2 W/m², narrowband (340 nm) irradiance 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m², black-panel temperature 63 ± 3 °C and relative humidity 50 ± 10 %.

text: Preparation of test specimens for the accelerated artificial weathering test shall be in accordance with the general guidelines given in EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
quote: Preparation of test specimens shall be in accordance with the general guidelines given in EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
test_case: Review specimen preparation records for conformity with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 guidelines.

text: For the resistance to fuels test, a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied to the retro-reflective device.
quote: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either:
test_case: Confirm the fuel resistance test used a 70/30 vol.% n-heptane/toluol mixture on the retro-reflector.

text: After about five minutes following the wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually and must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
quote: After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually. It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks
test_case: Visually inspect the surface about five minutes after wiping; pass if no apparent surface change other than slight surface cracks.

text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture of 70 vol. per cent n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent toluol.
quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
test_case: Wipe the retro-reflector outer/illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture and record the procedure.

text: After the resistance to fuels test, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
quote: It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
test_case: About five minutes after wiping with the 70/30 n-heptane/toluol mixture, visually inspect the surface; pass if no apparent surface changes other than slight cracks are seen.

text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after the lubricating oil exposure and cleaning, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
quote: The RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
condition: Retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: Measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. after the oil test and verify the values meet the limits required by that paragraph.

text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
condition: Retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: Wipe the outer and illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil and record that the exposure was applied.

text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after about 5 minutes of exposure to the detergent lubricating oil, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
quote: After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.
condition: Retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: After about 5 minutes of oil exposure, clean the surface and confirm it is free of residue before measurement.

text: In the approval mark affixed to the retro-reflective device, the approval number must be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
quote: The above approval number must be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the retro-reflector and confirm the approval number is located close to the circle surrounding the letter E.

text: In the approval mark affixed to the retro-reflective device, the digits constituting the approval number must face the same way as the "E".
quote: The digits constituting the approval number must face the same way as the "E".
test_case: Inspect the approval mark and confirm the approval number digits are oriented in the same direction as the letter E.

text: In the approval mark affixed to the retro-reflective device, the group of symbols indicating the class must be diametrically opposite the approval number.
quote: The group of symbols indicating the class must be diametrically opposite the approval number.
test_case: Inspect the approval mark and confirm the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) is placed diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the E circle.
